dkar chagamon yul ni sngar nas krung go'i mnga' khongs yin pa'i lo rgyus dpang rtags/ chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs/ ( 1 )di lir gsang ba'i yig rigs brje len byas pa der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis khas len byas rigs med pa/ lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje/ ( 10)nyin rdu btsan 'dzul dmag gis mon khul du btsan 'dzul byas pa'i don dngos/ zub bstan chos 'phel/ (24)nyin rdu btsan 'dzul dmag la gdong gtugs kyis kha rdung btang ba/ mar kong ye shes dgra 'dul/ (44)nga dang nyin rdu btsan 'dzul dmag dbar byung ba'i rtsod gleng zhig smin gling zla mchog (60)sbas chags shri ni rang rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bston med yin/ zhing sdong / (65)nga sgar chags gzhis sdod las thog skabs hin rdu'i btsan 'dzul dmag gis sbas chags shri btsan bzung byas pa'i

gnas tshul dngos/ bde rab tsho rdor/ ( 73 )nga smag sgor khral bsdur bskyod skabs 'gog rkyen 'phrad pa'i gnas tshul dngos/ dpal 'byor/ ( 78 )19kyi 2 lor rta dbang la bskyod skabs kyi mthong thos/ bsod nams dpal 'byor/ ( 83 )dzñorje /'bangs rnams kyi rigs rus gsal ba'i sgron me〉(mon chos 'byung)zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (87)

mon yul ni sngar nas krung go'i mnga' khongs yin pa'i lo rgyus dpang rtags/chagespel tshe brtan phun tshogs/pyong gyin sa mtshams dum bu shar ma'i rgyun srol goms gshis sa thig nas khrims 'gal gyi‘‘me khe ma hung sa thig ’zer ba'i bar du yod pa'i mon yul dang /sto yul/ rdza yul gyi smad phyogs bcas tshud pa'i sa khul de ni gna' rabs nas bzung thog mtha' bar gsum du krung go'i bod ljongs kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i sa gnas bston med cig yin/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog sa cha de dag gi spyi ming la mon yul dang / khul der gnas shing 'tsho ba'i mi la mon pa zhes 'bod srol yod/ dper na bod kyi lo rgyus yig thog tu 'khod snga shos su grags pa'i〈yo ga lha gyes can〉nang gnya' khri btsan po yar lung du byon pa'i‘6gshegs rabs nyi shu rtsa bdunami’zhes pa'i khrod du lam bar bud kyi gram snar mon gyi byis pa gsum dang 'phrad pa mnyam du khrid pa de dag ni lho/ snyags/ myang gsum gyi thog ma'i mes po yin tshul sogs(lde'u chos 'byung dpe rnying bris ma'i shog grangs 133rgyab phreng 4par gsal)'khod yod cing / mdor na bod kyi lo rgyus yig tshang phal mo che'i nang du mang nyung la ma bstos par mon gyi skor ma gsal ba ha lam med/de'i thog nas mon yul ni gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus thog nas bod ljongs dang kha 1

bril thabs med pa de gang legs mtshon gyi yod/ mon zhes pa'i tha snyad de yang sa bab dma' zhing ri rong dog pa dang gdod ma'i nags tshal stug pos khebs pa'i sa khul la thogs pa'i gna' bo'i bod kyi brda rnying zhig yin te bod yig gi tshig mdzod du ma'i nang du gsal yod/sa khams chags tshul thog nas bshad na/ bod kyi btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs lha sa gtsug lag khang bzhengs dus ru gnon dang / mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul sogs bod kyi sa khongs yongs la brtsigs skabs srin mo'i‘‘ lag thil g.yon la tho gar gyis lag dpon byas te mon skyer chu’ lha khang sogs bzhengs pa dang / 'byung ba'i kha snon gyi gras su‘‘ lhor me'i kha sgon snang gro dang gling thang gnyis’’bzhengs zhes〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉sogs chos 'byung mang por gsal ba ltar mon yul ni gna' rabs bod ljongs kyi sa khru srin mo gan rkyal nyal gzugs kyi khongs su gtogs pa gleng med kyis ra 'phrod byung yod/mi rigs kyi thog ma'i rus rgyud chad khungs nas bshad na'ang / bod mi'i thog ma'i rus tsho gyes lugs skor‘‘ldong dang stong gnyis se dang rmya gnyis te mi'u rigs bzhir grags te/ bod yul kha ba can gyi mi la snga ba yang de rnams yin nomi zhes bka' chems ka khol ma sogs rgyal rabs dang chos 'byung mang por yongs grags su gsal ba ltar mi'u rigs bzhi'i khams mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba bshad pa'i skor〈dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉nang‘‘rus chen bzhi las gyes pa'i khams/ ye sa dkar po gnam gyi 'ju thag can dang gcig ye mon nag po khro chu'i pha bong 'dra ba dang gnyis/ spyang khrig ye shes lha'i sgron me dang gsum/ mon rdzu nag po khyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhir dbye ba byung ngo’ zhes mon nag po zhes rus bzhiri tha mar brtsi ba mtshon pa dang / yang〈rgya bod kyi yig 2

tshang mkhas pa dga' byed〉las‘‘yang lugs gcig la nang gi mi'u rigs bzhi ni/ gi shang rgya dang / gyim 'jang hor/ kha le mon dang / spu rgyal bod bzhi'o’ zhes dang / de dag so so'i gyes rabs kyi 'grel bshad nang du'ang ‘‘ mon pa rigs gsum byung ba ni/ mon rang rgyud pa dang / rgya bod mtshams kyi mi nyagargong po gsum mo’ zhes gsal ba ltar lho mon gyi khul 'di ni mon rang rgyud pa bya ba'i khongs su gtogs pa yin no/ gong gsal yig tshang de dag las mon pa(lho pa tshud)tsho'i thog ma'i rigs rgyud kyi mes po ni ches gdod ma'i dus su bod sa mtho'i gna' mi las gyes pa zhig yin pa mtshon zhing / lhag par(mon chos 'byung〉(bris ma shog grangs 47mdun phreng 7)las/ bod kyi rigs rus bzhi dang / de dag so so'i gyes rabs rus ming rnams bgrangs pa'i mjug tu‘‘sngon gyi dus su gangs can bod kyi rigs rus ming gi rtsa ba de dag las med mimices dang / yakhyad par kha bzhi'i lung phyogs 'di nyid kyi mi rnams bod yul nas lho mon la yong nas yun ring po song bas gong du brjod pa'i rigs rus kyi rgyud pa kho na yin 'dug kyang / lho mon gyi lung phyogs 'dir rgya bod kyi lugs ltar rigs rus la mtho dman gyi dbye ba med cing / mthong bkur che bar mi 'dzin pa las yig char ma bkod pa dang / khungs ma chod pa yin 'dugami’ces mon pa'i thog ma'i mi rgyud bod nas chad par bshad 'dug pa dang / yang(shog grangs 18mdun phreng 1)‘‘bod yul du rgyal po glang dar ma'i sras 'od srung dang /yum brtan gnyis rgyal srid la ma 'cham par dbus ru dang g.yu ru so sor phye nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du 'khrugal pas 'od srung pham nas mnga' ris stod du bros pas blon po rnams sto mon gyi phyogs su thor nas yong ba'i mi rnams kyis yul grong phan tshun de dus btab pa yin 'dug mices sogs gsal ba bcas mdor na mon yul du chags pa'i mi rnams kyi rtsa ba'i rigs rgyud kyang gzhi rtsa'i 3

ni nas bod rang nas chad pa lo rgyus kyi yig rigs mang por gsal yod/ de dag ni 'brel yod lo rgyus kyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul 'ga' zhig yin/de bas gal che ba ni mon yul de thogle/ mtha' bar gsum du bod kyi srid 'dzin mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos de yin/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i nang btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod yongs gcig gyur thengs dang po byung ba'i dus su ru chen lnga'i sa mtshams phye ba'i nang‘‘ g.yo ru'i ru mtshams ni/ shar kong yul bre sna/ nub kha rag spyi/ byang rma la la rgyud/ lho sha 'ug stag sgo/ dbus tshad yar lung khru 'brug go’’zhes(lde'u chos 'byung〉sogs bod kyi lo rgyus rgyas pa mang por gsal ba ltar mon sha 'ug stag sgo tshun chad ni bod kyi 'bangs rnal mar gtogs pa dang / de phan chod kyi mon yul yang bod kyi mnga' khongs rgyal phran bzhi'i gras su gtogs pa ha cang gsal po 'khod yod〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉(shing par ja pa'i shog grangs 20rgyab phreng 3par)g.yung gi mi sde 'byed pa'i nang‘‘ nam pa sde rgyal/bal po li rgyal/ sum pa lcags rgyal/ mon rtse rgyal zhes phyogs kyi rgyal po bzhis dpya bsdus nas 'bul bas 'bangs la gtogs soririzhes 'khod pa ltar〈lde'u chos 'byung〉dang〈chos 'byung chen mo bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan〉sogs tshang mar gsal thag chod 'khod yod/ skabs de'i rgyal phran bzhi po de so so'i tha snyad la dpyad na'ang / yul gyi cha rkyen nam thon khungs gtso bo gang yin pa de la brten nas ming btags par mngon te/ de yang nam pa sde rgyal ni mi sde mang ba'i rgyal phran yin pa dang / bal po li rgyal ni lcags rigs bzhu nas pakhro dbyibs sna ༷tshogs su lugs brgyab pa'i thon rdzas li zhes 'bod cing / de lta bu'i li ma'i dngos po mang po thon pa'i rgyal phran yin pa/ sum pa lcags rgyal ni sa 'og lcags gter 'beel shos kyi rgyal ṅgin yin pa bcas mtshon zhing / de ltar na mon rtse rgyal zhes 4

pa'ang rtswa shing gi rtse mor smin pa'i rtsi tog ste thon khungs bzang shos kyi rgyal phran yin pas/ mon rtse rgyal lam/ rtsi rgyal du btags pa yin snyam‘‘phyogs kyi rgyal po bzhes bca' bsdus nas 'bul’ zhes pa'ang rang gi thon khungs gang bzang ba bca' skyes su 'bul ba smos ma dgos pas/ mon gyi 'go pas kyang mon pa rnams nas 'bru rigs dang 'bras bu'i rigs kyi khrul bsdus nas lo re bzhin bod kyi btsan por dpya khrul 'bul dgos pa'i bod 'bangs su gtogs pa de la mi lo 1300lhag gi lo rgyus ldan pa bod kyi tshad ldan rgyal rabs yig rnying du ma nas ra 'phrod kyi yod/ de ltar btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyis bod yongs la dbang bsgyur pa'i ring mon yul bod kyi mnga' khongs su gnas pas ma tshad/ bod sil bur thor ba'i dus yun la'ang mon yul ni bod kyi btsan po'i gdung rgyud kyi dbang 'dzino byed pa'i mnga' 'og tu gnas yod/ de yang khri ral pa can gyi dus su dbas stag sna sogs blon 'bangs rnams kyis chos khrims la rgol ba'i 'dun gros byed skabs‘‘rgyal po ma bkrongs na chos khrims bshig mi nus zer/ la la na re rgyal po bkrongs kyang lha sras gtsang ma dang btsun mo ngang tshul ma dang ban chen po rnams yod pas bshig mi nus zer/ der dbas stag sna can gyis sngon du de dag med par byas la de nas rgyal po bkrongs zer nas mo ma dang phywa mkhan rnams la rngan pa byin te lha sras gtsang ma 'dir bzhugs na rgyal khrims 'jig pas sprug dgos zer du bcug de kun tu grags pa'i tshe rgyal po'i snyan du gsol nas mon yul du sprugs’’〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉(ja 134)sogs lo rgyus chos 'byung mang por gsal yod/ 'on kyang de dag nang lha sras gtsang ma mon du phebs nas lha khang bzhengs pa dang / chos dpe gter du sbas tshul/ de rjes sku gshegs tshul tsam las ma gsal ba de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ chos 'byung khag gi nang lha sras gtsang ma dam— pa'i chos kho nar thugs gzhol bas rgyal srid kyang ma bskos pa de/5

glang dar ma chos la gnag pa'i ldog zlar mngon gsal du bsgrags zin par brten khong mon yul du phebs rjes btsun mo bzhes pa dang sras rgyud 'phel ba'i lo rgyus de dag chos 'byung gi gtso bo'i brtsam byar dgos pa med dgongs par zad cing /'on kyang de'i skor zhib phra lha sras gtsang ma rang gi dbon rgyud kyis brtsams pa'i〈mon chos 'byung〉ngam/ yang na(rje 'bangs rnams kyi rigs rus 'byung khungs gsal ba'i sgron me〉zhes pa'i nang de'i thad zhib cing phra ba gsal ba las/ 'dir gnad bsdus tsam drangs na/ gtsang ma khrum snar bzhugs skabal‘‘sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig zer ba'i skad cha thos byung ba dang / bod yul dang thag nye ba'i gshis kyis der bzhugs ma spro bar 'brong mdo gsum btsan mkhar la phebs nas rgyal sa bzung ba'i 'os gang la 'dug gzigs pas mi zim pa'i sa cha de chu brag gis bskor zhing / lung pa 'dus che la sa btsan pa 'dug dgongs nas der phebs pas de na a mi don grub rgyal zer ba'i mi zhig gis bdag po byed pa'i mi khyim zhig 'dug par/ lha sras kyis don grub rgyal la gsungs pa/ khyod rnams 'dir 'ongs nas mi rab ji tsam song / rigs rus dang lung phyogs gang nas yin zer bar rdon grub rgyal gyis smra ba/ yul phyogs bod yul nas nga'i pha ma'i dus la yong ba yin/ rigs rus ni slob dpon padma'i dngos slob a mi byang chub 'dre bkol(rlangs khams pa go cha)rlangs lha gzigs kyi rgyud pa yin/ byar po'i yul du yod par pha spun nang 'khrugs nas mnga' 'bangs dbang rgyu ma byung ba las 'dir yong ba yin zer ba'i lo rgyus zhib cha zhus pas lha sras kyang yid ches nas der gnas tshang bca' nas bzhugs mi’zhes gsal zhing / 〈rlangs kyi po ti bse ru〉las kyang‘‘rlangs seng ge 'dul gyis lha ru mon lha spyi gom de mchod nas mon la dmag drangs pas/ mon gyi rgyal khams de cham la phab/ de'i dpa' rtaṭa su mon gyi chu stag mi zan de bzung nas dpa' ba'i 'dzom drug de bkol nas 6

'phru la btsugs/ mon kha bzhi de 'bangs su bkol nas de bas dpa' ba'i stag 'phru 'dzugs mi dang / mon 'bangs su bkol mi yang lha gzigs rlangs yin’’(lcags par ma'i ngeb ngos 33)zhes 'khod 'dug de nas mon chos 'byung nang mu mthud 'khod par‘‘a mi don grub rgyal gyi bu mo bsod nams dpal sbyin lha sras gtsang ma'i btsun mor blangs pas/ sras khri mi lha'i dbang phyug dang / bu mthong legs can gnyis 'khrungs nas sku nar son pa dang mi khyim yul grong thor bur yod pa rnams la dbang bsgyur nas rgyal mkhar brtsigs pas bod chos rgyal gyi gdung zhes grags pa cher song ba dang / khri mi lha'i dbang phyug de la 'og yul gsum nas blon 'bangs rnams kyis rje dpon gyi gnas su gdan drangs nas phebs pas phyis sras rgyud rnams lha'u khams pa la bzhugs pas jo bo zer ba'i ming de las gragasami’(deb ngos 16—17)zhes dang / de'i sras rgyud gsum ba‘‘bskos lde de nyid kyis yab mes gong ma rnams kyi yig tshang la gzigs shing /phyag srol ji lta ba bzhin la dpe blangs nas mdzad pal lung phyogs phal cher mnga' 'bangs la 'dus shing dbang bsgyur’’zhes dang‘‘sras dpal mthong legs ni smad gdung bsam phyogs la gdan drangs pa de'i sras rgyud rnams kyis skya sa mkhar gyi sa'i char rgyal mkhar brtsigs shing rgyal sa bzung / de las so sor gyes pa nas rgyal po snga tshang dang phyi tshang zer ba de las byung ba yin’ (deb ngos 19)zhes gsal ba sogs lha sras gtsang ma'i sras de gnyis las rim par 'phel ba'i dbon sras rnams kyis mon yul gyi lung tshan so sor dbang bsgyur pa'i sa ming dang / dbon sras so so'i mtshan bcas gsal bar 'khod 'dug kyang 'dir tshang ma brjod kyis mi langs shing bod btsan po'i gdung rgyud kyis mon yul du rgyal mkhar brtsigs pa la cha mtshon rung / lngas chung thum nang mkhar dang / skya sa mkhar/ 'dre spong / seng mkhar bkra shis sgang / kha gling / la 'og yul gsum 7

despul mkhar/ kho long stod/ shar dom kha/ tsha se/ o rdza rong / sa gling rgyag mtshams/ sgam ri'i chu rgyud/ 'dus nyung mkhar/ sgang zung stod/ shar grang ma chu rgyud/ sde 'am rdzong / ber mkhar/ sde rang rdzong / shar stag lung me rag sag steng / ra ti rgyal mkhar la sogs par mkhar rdzong dngos su brtsigs shing /mon yul de dag so sor dbang bsgyur pa ma zad/ rje dpon re zung gis rgya gar gyi las sgo la dbang byed pa dang / lam khrul len pa sogs kyang byed myong ba bcas zhib phra〈mon chos 'byung)nang 'khod yod/ mdor na spyi lo'i dus rabs dgu pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu yas mas la lha sras gtsang ma mon yul du phebs pa nas/chos 'byung 'di'i brtsams lo rab byung bcu pa'i sa sprel spyi lo 1608 bar mi lo bdun brgya lhag tsam song ba'i ring der lha sras gtsang ma'i gdung rgyud mi rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum tsam gyis mon gyi yul tsho so sor dbang bsgyur byas yod pa lo rgyus kyi yig cha de'i thog nas khungs skyel gang legs byed thub kyi yod/ mon chos 'byung 'di rtsom pa po yang lha sras gtsang ma'i dbon sras kyi rgyud kha gling gi rgyal rigs lha btsun ngag dbang phun tshogs bya ba mon yul rang du 'khrungs shing 'tsho ba dang / yab mes kyi yig tshang la 'dris pa che ba zhig yin pas snga rabs mon gyi lo rgyus skor la bod kyi rgyal rabs dang / chos 'byung gzhan gang gis kyang 'gran thabs bral ba'i yig rigs khungs btsun yid brton 'pher ba 'ba' zhig yin no/spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus sked tsam nas bod sa gnas kyi chab srid dbang cha tā la'i lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtshos bdag gir bzhes shing / de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi phyi nang sgrig gzhi rim 'dzugs gnang ba'i brgyud rim nang lho mon kha mtshams su mtsho sna rdzong bsko 'dzugs dang 'brel mon yul gyi srid 'dzin do dam mtsho sna rdzong khongs gtogs pa gnang / de rjes me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho sogs brgyud mon yul gyi bdag gnyer bkod sgrig —8

mdzad pa dang / bod rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags bya spyi lo 1681lor mon rta dbang dga' ldan rnam rgyal lha rtse chos sde gsar 'dzugs mdzad par gtong sgo byings lhun rtse rdzong dang / mtsho sna rdzong nas sprod dgos bka' bstsal zhing / ja dang gos dar sogs lha sa phyag mdzod nas gnang ba'i skor tā la'i lnga pa'i gsung rnam〈du kū la'i gos bzang〉pod ga pa'i shog grangs 226nang 'khod 'dug de rjes mon yul gyi phyi rgya'i srid 'dzin sngar bzhin mtsho sna rdzong khongs su gtogs kyang / sa gnas de ga'i nang khul do dam dang rta dbang dgon pa'i bdag gnyer bcas su rta dbang bla gnyer zhes gzhung zhabs rtse drung gcig bsko rdzong byed lam bcas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi yig rigs rab dang rim par gsal 'khod yod cing / mornga yul nang gses tsho lding sum cu so gnyis su phye yod pa ni/legs po tsho bzhi dang / spang chen sding drug dwags po tsho brgyad/ la 'og yul gsum/ sbrang snang tsho drug rong nang tsho bzhi/ sha 'ug khro byang bcas yin/mdor bsdus na/ bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha'i thog nas mon yul ni gdod ma nas bzung bod dang kha bral myong med pa ma zad/ lhag par bod rje srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod gcig gyur byung ba'i dus nas bzung mi lo 1300lhag tsam song ring du'ang thog mtha' bar gsum du bod kyi mnga' khongs su gnas pa'i don dngos kyi lo rgyus bden dpang phun sum tshogs pa ldan yod do/

gi ler gsang ba'i yig rigs brje len byas pa der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis khas len byas rigs med pa/lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje/krung hin sa mtshams kyi gnad don ni lo rgyus thog lus bsdad pa'i sne mang 'dres 'dzings kyi gnad don zhig yin cing / gnad don de gleng skabs dbyin gos gyin rdu dbang bsgyur byed pa'i ring la krung go'i bod sa gnas su btsan 'dzul byas pa'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab rten la thog mar bsam gzhig mi byed mthu med red/ ha cang snga ba'i dus skabs su dbyin gos krung go'i bod sar btsan 'dzul byed pa'i ham sems bcangs pa ma zad/ btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug kyang thengs gnyis brgyab pa dang / de rjes go skabs dang bstun te dbyin gos bod la rgyun mi chad par shog spug rlung 'tshangs kyis krung go nas kha bral du bcug ste/ming thog tu sger langs yin tshul gyis don du bod 'di dbyin go'i bkag sdom 'og 'jog rgyu'i rtsis ngan bcangs pa red/ lkog g.yo ngan jus de dag lam du ma lhongs pa'i rjes su dbyin gos krung gor gnon shugs sna tshogs spyad de bod 'di dbyin go'i dbang shugs khongs su 'jog rgyu'i re 'dun bton te bod la 'dzin pa'i bdag po'i dbang cha zer ba de krung gos nyar 'jog byed du 'jug rtsi sa byas 10

pa red/ de yang ma 'grub stabs dbyin gos hin rdu rten gzhir byas te krung go'i bod sa gnas su mnga' khongs btsan shugs rgya bskyed byas pa red/da lta dum bu shar ma mon khul skor zhu rgyur/1 krung go'i bod sa gnasajisrid gzhung gis dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus dkyil du mon khul dang / klo yul/ rdza yul smad ma bcas khag gsum po gcig tu chags pa'i sa khul der do dam byed kyi yod cing / lhag par mon sa khul la cha mtshon na dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus dkyil du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa mchog gis bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang 'dzin skyong mdzad pa'i rjes su khong gi slob ma me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho dang / mtsho sna'i lding dpon nam mkha' 'brug grags mon yul sa khul du gtong gnang gis srid dbang btsugs pa dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mon pa dud rkang zhib bsher gyis gzhung khru yang 'god gnang mdzad thog me rag bla ma'i 'dzin dbang bdag thob skor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas bka' gtan yang gnang yod pa red/2 dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus 'gor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mon yul hril po gong bu gcig gyur bzos te snga rting du sa khul de yongs la tsho dang lding zer ba sum cu so gnyis btsugs pa ma zad/ mon khul rta dbang bzhi sbrel dang / rta dbang drug sbrel(bzhi sbrel ni bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas bsko gzhag byas pa'i rta dbang gnyer pa ser skya gnyis dang / 'bras blo gling gi bsko gzhag byas pa'i mkhan po/ rta dbang grwa tshang gi bla ma las sne bcas dang /drug sbrel ni bzhi sbrel thog mtsho sna rdzong ser skya gnyis bsnan)zhes 'go khrid las khungs btsugs te mon rta dbang de srid 'dzin gyi lte gnas byas nas sa khul yongs kyi 'go khrid byed kyi yod pa red/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dus rtag tu mon yul sa khongs rim pa khag gi srid 'dzin las khungs la dpon rigs 11

gtong ba dang / sa khul yongs gyi sa gnas khag nas khral bogs(gtso bo 'brurigs)bsdu len byed pa ma zad/ khrims 'dzin gyi dbang cha yang 'dzin gyi yod/bod kyi them dud la zhib 'jug rim par byed skabs mon yul de bzhin bod khongs kho nar brtsis pa las zur du 'bud myong med/ dper na/ mtsho sna rdzong sdod gsar pa dang rnying pa rtsis sprod len skabs mon khul gyi mi ser la zhib bsher byas pa'i rkang gzhung dang dud tho yod pa ma zad/ chu khyi lor bkod pa'i gzhung khru nang gsal du'ang mon tsho 3/ shar tsho sde pa dud 299/ se ru ba dud 244/lta'u dud 165/ yul gsum pa dud 24/ bra hong stag pa dud 44/dag pa padma mkhar pa dud 93/ mthong leb pa dud 60/ bskungs pa dud 30/ 'khri lam dud 70/ mang lam pa dud 35/ 'bras pa tsho dud 127/'ung la tsho pa dud 121/ legs po ba dud 272/shar phyogs yul tsho/ ddhi rang pa 63/ them spang pa 46/ stug span pa 40/ shar gdong kha pa 35bcas yod ces gsal zhing / sa gnas de ga'i mi dmangs kyis rgyun du bod yig dang bod dngul spyod kyi yod pa ma zad/ sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa byed pa dang / dpal 'byor dang rig gnas 'tsho ba sogs gang thad la bod rigs kyi shugs rkyen ha cang gting zab yod/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho ni mon yul du 'khrungs pa dang / khong gi 'khrungs khang gi mi rgyud la bod sa gnas srid dbang rim byung gis bka' gtan dang gzigs skyong gnang gi yod la bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sa khul de dag la rgya khyab kyi sgo nas do dam dbang cha mu mthud lag len bstar gyi yod pa/ dper na/ 1951 lo'i bar mon khul du yo da pa'i bod kyi srid sedzin las khungs cha tshang zhig bsdad yod pa red/ klo yul dang rdza yul smad mar myo/tshon na 1946lo'i gong du tsho dang lding gi srid 'dzin las khungs 1ཿ

geng sa gang du bsdad yod pa ma zad/ bod sa gnas sgrid gzhung gi rlud dbang 'dzin mkhan la sho khrul 'jal ba dang / 'u lag kyang rgyugs dgos kyi yod pa sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis nam yin rung sa khul der do dam dbang cha spyad dang spyod bzhin pa red/ snga dus nas bzung shar phyogs mon mtshams a 'bar ta lar dbyin jis bod gzhung la lo re sa gla dbyin sgor chig stong 'bul mus nas lo rer sgor lnga brgya tham pa rta dbang grwa tshang dang skad bsgyur sogs la sprad 'phros dbyin sgor lnga brgya tham pa re lo ltar bka' shag tu 'bab kyi 'dugang rang bka' mgron byed dus sa gla dbyin sgor lnga brgya bka' shag tu phul 'byor gyi byung 'dzin yang 'bri myong / gong gsal lo rgyus dngos kyi gnas tshul ni de ltar yin/3 spyi lo 1914bod shing stag lor sim lar rgya bod dbyin gsum gyi gros tshogs shig 'tshogs pa red/ gros tshogs nang zhugs mkhan krung go'i sku tshab khren dbyis hphan dang / bod sa gnas kyi sku tshab srid blon bshad sgra/ dbyin gzhung sku tshab meg me hon bcas tshogs skabs phan tshun don tshan mang po bton res byas te 'phros mol byed ring sim la'i ching yig zer ba 'jog rgyu'i skor dbyin jis bod la rgyab skyor rogs ram byas lugs kyis mon phyogs kyi sa mtshams nas phran bu dgongs bzhes gnang dgos zhes zhu lugs bshad sgra blon chen nas sne mgron mkhan chung bstan pa dar rgyas lha sar btang bar/ de lan srid blon zhol khang nas srid blon bshad sgrar btang yig nang sne mgron 'di gar 'byor te gsung mol byung don dbyin gzhung thugs pham med pa dgongs bzhes gnang mus la mdzad bde'i gnas tshul phul chog ces dang / yang tar zhig btang ba'i nang da lam dbyin gzhung nas gcod rgya gnang khongs stag rong dang / sde dgetsho pa so dgu/ 'dam brgya shog kyang bod khongs rtsod med bya rgyu khas len byas 13

min tar 'phral stsol yong ba zhes dang / da dung srid blon dam sbyar gyi yi ge brwang za'i nang dbyin gzhung nas bstan srid skye 'gror phan rlabs che ba'i bden rgyab ngo thon gnang tshe mon khul sa mi dbyin jir stsal 'os bka' shag dang / spyi mkhan bcas gros bsdur gyi gnas tshul phul chog ces pa las tshig thag chod pa'i lan gsal ba/nyeng mi 'dug sim la'i gros tshogs 'tshogs pa'i mtha' mjug sim la'i ching yig zer ba'i thog krung go'i sku tshab khren dbyis hphan gyis rtags the'u ma brgyab pa red/ der brten dbyin go'i sku tshab dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab gnyis kyis spyi lo 1914zla 3 tshes 24nyin di lir gsang ba'i sgo nas khrims 'gal gyi yig rigs brje len byed stangs la ba/rten nas me khe ma hung sa thig zer ba bzos pa red/spyi lo 1914bod shing stag zla 4 tshes 23 nyid tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog gis dbyin gzhung sku tshab meg me hon dang / chings don las rogs 'bel zer ba gnyis la phyag bris gnang ba'i nang sku gnyis phyir phebs ma gnang gong krung go'i sku tshab nas chings yig la rtags 'jog 'khrun chod yong ba gsung 'dug kyang / dbyin jis nus pa thon ma thub par gros tshogs de 'thor ba red/ sim la'i chings yig gi zur bkod sa khru'i nang bod kyi sa mtshams sa khru zur yod la rtags dmar po dang / bod nang ma dang phyi ma'i sa mtshams rtags sngon po brgyab yod ces pa las/ sa mtshams gang yin dang / yul lung / sa ming sogs tshig gcig kyang ma bkod par skog g.yo ngan jus kyis bzos pa'i sa thig de bod ljongs su yongs bsgrags byed ma nus par nyar bsdad pa red/ de rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog gis srid blon bshad sgrar khyed rang sim lar bskyod de chings yig 'jog rgyu'i skor thog mtha' bar gsum gyi lo rgyus gnas tshul yig cha bzo dgos phebs don/ srid blon bshad sgra nas yi ge 14

phyob/sa sgrig byed bzhin pa'i skabs glo bur 'das grongs song ba red/spyi lo 1920bod lcags sprel zla 10tshes 20nyin 'bras spyi blon chen 'bel tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog mjal 'phrad skabs di lir gsang ba'i sgo nas khrims 'gal gyi yig rigs brje len byas pa'i sim la'i chings yig 'bru don ltar don 'khyol yong re zhu rtsis byed skabs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog nas sim lar chings sgrig bka' mol gnang ba lab 'khrun gtsang chod ma byung bar mu 'byams su lus pa thag gcod yong thabs gsungs par/ kho pas chings sgrig bka' mol 'khrun thag gtsang chod ma byung bar mu 'byams su lus rtsa bod phyogs kyi don tshan rnams la dbyin gzhung nas gang drag yong thabs gnang rkyen rgya phyogs nas nyan 'jog ma byas pas chings yig kyang bzhag ma thub cing / de rjes zi khron dang / zhing chen khag la 'khrug zing byung khar/ yon hri khas kyang 'das grongs song rjes zhing chen tshang mar dbang bsgyur thub pa'i pad cin du rgya gzhung(krung dbyang)zhig med stabs dbyin gzhung nas bka' mol gnang rgyu don med yin tshul zhus pa tsam las/ de nas bzung rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa gser zhal 'tsho bzhugs ḍasding de'i skor skad cha tshig gcig kyang med par 'jam thing nger bsdad pa red/gong lo'i zla 12tshes 1 3la srid blon zhol khang pas bka' blon tsha rong la btang yig nang dbyin jis srid blon tshogs 'thus bcas la mon la dkar chung man nan zhus skor shin tu gsang rgya gnang gras srid blon dam bas gsungs thoga'abel blon(dbyin ji'i mi)lha phebs gsungs mol byung ba las chings yig zur pa zhig yod 'dug kyang / da lta'ang mig mthong ma byung ba dza sag bsod legs(legs ldan zer)kyis kyang blor nges yod nges la rgya bod chings 'khrun gtsang chod mtshams dbyin jis mon khul sa mi rtsis sprod dgos lugs mdzad dka' zhu 15

nyen che zhes btang 'dug stabs gnas tshul de'i thog nas chings yig skor srid blon las sbrel gyis kyang gsal po shes kyi med pa rtogs thub/ gzhi rkang me khe ma hung sa thig zer ba ni dbyin gos krung go'i bod sa gnas la btsan 'dzul srid jus lag len bstar ba las byung ba'i ngan 'bras shig yin pa dang / de'i skor krung go'i krung dbyang srid gzhung su 'dra zhig gis kyang khas len rtsa ba nas gnang med/ de 'brel bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang 'dzin mkhan tshos kyang me khe ma hung sa thig zer ba snga phyir khas len rtsa ba nas byas med pa ma zad/ sa thig de la mi 'dod pa'i khong khro chen po byed kyi yod/4 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa zhal ma bzhugs pa'i rjes su dbyin gos bsam btang dran rnyed kyis spyi lo 1938bod sa stag lor nga rang lo 25la slebs pa bka' shag nang bka' mgron gyi las 'gan 'khur gyi yod/ de dus bka' shag tu mtsho sna rdzong nas snyan zhu 'byor gsal/ nye char u ru ku re'i ces pa rta dmag bcas 'byor pa nas rta dbang man dbyin jir bdag tshul gyis gzhung sa'i chab 'bangs khrul rigs 'khri cha ji yod lkog 'dri tho bkod dang /rta dbang grwa tshang la lag rtags gya nom pa sprad de sa cha 'phrog sems sogs bya spyod je ngan gyi yong rkyen gang la gzhigs kyang blos 'gan bzod min 'dug ces gsal skor/ bka' shag gros bsdur gyis phyir lan du shing stag lo sim lar rgya dbyin bod gsum chings 'jog skabs rgya bod zhi mthun bka' mol mjug 'khrun chod pa med stabs sa rigs skor dbyin bod bka' mol ma grub bar rang bzhin dbyin gzhung nas lam seng dbye 'byed btsan bdag shes min ma zad/ 'di ga nas kyang bka' mol zhal bzhes gnang thabs med nges dang / de 'brel dbyin jis de khul mi ser nas sger gzhung so sor khral 'bab ji 'dra 'phul dgos lkog 'dri tho bkod dang / sa cha 'phrog sems pha rol ngan g.yo'i nang mi tshud pa'i 16

bsam pa gcig bsgril dgos zhes btang bar/ mon 'bangs spyi nas dbyin ji'i 'og tu tshud 'dod med pa'i rtags mtshan bstan te dbyin ji'i g.yo 'og mi tshud pa bya rgyu'i bkod don 'gal med byed sgo'i mna' gan bzhag ste 'go rgan dang spyi 'thus bcas mi grangs 101gis rtags the'u brgyab pa'i gan rgya 'byor song /yang phyogs gcig nas bka' shag gis lha sar yong ba'i dbyin ji'i gro mo tshong spyi/ ra yi rta dur—o 'bai—i(bod ming nor bu)zer bar/ mon khul sa mtshams skor rtsod gleng btsan 'dzul mi chog rnga4'i gnas tshul zhib cha btang ba ma zad/ kho par bskyar bcag kyang nan tan byas stabs skabs gcig ring skad cha de 'jam song /1944bod shing spre'i zla 9nang mtsho sna rdzong sbrel nas gnas tshul btang don/ mtsho sna rdzong khongs mon dhi rang sa gnas su dbyin ji'i 'go dmag lhags 'byor thog rong nang stod smad dang / sbrang nang tsho drug khongs su khrims 'go gnon sdom byed rkyang byed pas mi tshad/ rgyang gzhis brgyud rdzong 'bab khrul dang / rdzong skyong gzhis 'bru sogs gzhung 'bab rigs sprod len mi chog pa'i bkag 'gog sogs dgos dbang btsan shed thog sa mi 'phrog rgyu'i g.yo thabs ma bdag bdag bzung ji snyed byas lugs gsal skor bka' shag dang / drung rtsis brgyad sbrel tshogs 'du 'tshogs te srid skyong stag brag la snyan seng yig cha phul song(skabs der nga rang rtsis dpon gyi las 'gan 'khur gyi yod/ rang lo 31yin)/ de dus mtsho sna rdzong sdod dang rta dbang bzhi sbrel bcas par rang re bod gzhung nas sa mi dbyin jir gnang rigs gtan nas med nges la de lugs dkrog rkyen gleng lhag mi 'byung ba'i zhi 'jam thabs mkhas thog nas stag dhi rdzong gsar pa ched rdzong kyis rang sa rang spung sngar lam byed sgo che phra 'thus shor med pa dgos skor bka' rgya snga phyir btang song / de'i skor 1945bod zla 4tshes snye7

8 nyin mtsho sna rdzong hphal dang / rta dbang bzhi sbrel nas dhi rang du dbyin ji'i a sam lar chung ba skye ming 'ji si mi'i si zer ba dang / spyi khyab im dhi—dhi a mi—spol li'i gri kal—a pi sar zer ba/ bla ma 'ba' bu a cung tshe ring zer ba gsum thug 'phrad kyil snga lo dhi rang du dbyin ji'i 'go dmag 'byor bsdad 'di rnams da cha phyir 'then gnang dgos ma zad/ nga tsho khral bsdu khrims gnon sngar mus byed rgyu yin lugs bshad par/ spyi khyab sa heb nas‘‘shar ze la man gyi sa mi'i dbang rigs dbyin gzhung la gnang ste lo sum cu so gnyis tsam song ba red/ na ning bar du bdag po rgyag rgyu ma byung / da cha ze la man gyi mi ser dbyin gzhung la bdag tshar bar brten rdzong nas khrul bsdus na 'grigs kyi ma red’’ces ze la man gnang byung zhes ham pa stag rkyang gis za sems byed 'dug ze la man dhi rang tsho drug dang / sbrang nang tsho bzhi zhes stag dhi rdzong 'og tsho bcu las mi 'dug kyang / don du ri klung sa rgya dang / dge bde/ yul grong / mi grangs sogs gang thad nas rgya khyon che thog rta dbang grwa tshang gi phogs dmigs a ma trī stag rdzong gnyis yin ces pa'i gnas tshul btang 'dug de rjes dbyin jis btsan shugs kyis spyi lo 1945dang 1946lo nang dhi stag rdzong dang /seng rdzong sogs mon khul ze la man rim bzhin btsan bzung byas pa red/6 spyi lo 1947bod me phag lor nyin rdu rang btsan byung skabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung nang dbyin jis nyin rdu rang btsan sprod rgyu'i rtsis len rtsis sprod byed pa'i dus skabs 'dir dbyin jis bar lam rang khongs mon sa btsan bzung byas pa rnams tshur len 'phros mol bya rgyu'i dus tshod gal che red ces gros mol byung ste bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas paṇa ta ni rong dang / 'bi lar dbyin gzhung gi don gcod sku tshab so sor 'bul rgyu'i dbyin yig gnas tshul khag gnyis phul don du/ dbyin jis lugs dang mi mthun pa'i btsan bzung byas 1 8

pa'i bod sa lho phyogs kyi sa gnas mnga' khongs yongs rdzogs phyir sprod dgos pa'i re 'dun bton song / (skabs der nga rang bka' shag nang bka' blon gyi las 'gan 'khur gyi yod/ rang lo 34la slebs yod)de lan 1947zla 12tshes 12nyin rgyal rtser bca' sdod rgya gar gzhung gi don gcod sku tshab dang rgyal rtse tshong spyi gcig lcogs ri car san brgyud lan gsal byung ba'i nang slar rgya gar gzhung dang / bod gzhung gnyis dbar don gnad gang ci'i skor phan tshun gnyis dge'i chings yig gsar bzo bskyar 'jog mdzad 'os ma byung bar phan tshun mthun lam mdzad phyogs gang ci da mus chings yig gzhir bzung gnang rgyu de bod gzhung rang gi dgongs gzhi yin zhes rgya gar gzhung la thugs blo bde ched khas len zhig gnang dgos 'dug des na bod gzhung nas gong zhus ltar zhal gsang ma gnang tshe rgya gar gzhung dang / bod gzhung gnyis ngabar tshong don gyi bka' mol gnang rgyuri skor gzhi rten rtsa 'dzin gnang yul gnyis mos legs lam chags pa zhig gtan nas yong gi ma red ces 'jigs skul byas yod rung /sa cha sprod rgyu'i khas len rtsa ba nas byas med/6 spyi lo 1951bod lcags yos lor mtsho sna rdzong sdod gnyis dang /rta dbang bzhi sbrel nas gnas tshul btang ba'i nang 1951lo'i zla 1tshes 1 nyin rta dbang du rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab gsum dang / skad bsgyur/ sba bu gnyis/dmag dkyus drug cu skor/ rlung 'phrin 'u dan/ 'phrul mda' rdzas mdel/ sto phogs sogs do po brgyad brgya bzhi bcu skor bcas 'dir 'byor la gus 'bangs drug sbrel gros bsdur gyis tshes 3 nyin don gnad ji yin spro 'dri byas par/ rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab nas brjod gsal de snga sim lar rgya bod chings sgrigs su phebs skabs mtsho mon gnyis kyi dbar sbo la man gyi sa khang mi gsum nga tsho rgya gar gzhung la gsol ras ga nang nas da bar lo ngo sum cu so drug tsam 'gro gi 1 sgyi

'dug pas/ da lam nga tsho bdag 'dzin byed par btang byung / rta dgon gyi chos lugs sogs la skyon 'gyur gang yang med par bzhi sbrel gyi sngar lam byed sgo rang 'jags byas 'thus dang / mtsho sna rdzong sbrel nas da phyin khral bsdu khrims gnon mi chog ces brjod byung bas gus 'bangs drug sbrel nang don gang 'gab gros bsdur gyis rgya gar sku tshab sar bskyod thog de sngon nas sbo la man gyi sa khang mi gsum gsol ras gnang yod tshe dbyin jis skabs sbyar bdag sprod bya rgyu ma zad/ rgya gar gzhung rang btsan byung skabs gsung gleng tsam med par da mtshams gnas dus tshod rtsis 'di rigs nam yang med pa gnang dgos lab par nyan sems ye nas med khar/ btsan dbang ham 'phrog byed rkyang byed 'dug pa dang / spyi lo 1944bod shing spre lor dbyin jis dhi rang du btsan 'dzul skabs thog mar rta grwa'i mchod rgyun la dge skyon med gshis bzhi sbrel byed sgo sngar lam ltar byas 'thus dang / rdzong gi khrul khrims bsdu gnon chog min skor da lta nang bzhin bkod khyab byas 'dug rung / don snying spyi lo 1946bod shing bya lor bzhi sbrel gyi mchod rgyun gtong sgo'i yong 'bab bsdu khungs rnams rtsa chad kyis deng skabs grwa tshang nyams rgud tha zhan du gyar gnas rtsa ba der thug pas/ slad kyang sngar 'gro phyis lam gyis mchod rgyun gtong rtsa rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyu dngos bstan la song sa mtha'i gzhung dgon khyad can nyams chag 'gro rgyu smos med khar/gzhung sa'i sa khang mi gsum btsan dbang 'di mur sdug 'khur nam ring sgrung 'khyongs dka' nges la 'di gar lhags 'byor rgya gar ba 'go dmag rnams phyir log 'gro thabs bka' mol gnang 'os zhes btang 'dug pa de'i skor spyi lo 1951bod lcags yos zla 2nang lha sa bka' shag nas gro mo bka' shag la btang yig nang mtsho mon gnyis nas snyan zhu rim 'byor khag zur phul zhus pa ltar srid tshab gnyis la snyan zhus kyis mon che la dang / mtsho mon dbar sdo lu man gi sa ཿ

khang mi gsum rgya gar gzhung la sprod rgyu byas tshul 'di thad sim la'i dbyin bod chings don la gsal 'khod med thog de rjes rang gzhung nas kyang khas len tshig thal gnang rigs gang yang med bzhin par rgya gar gzhung gi dpon dmag sa brgal rang sar rim lhags kyis gnas dus 'gro tshod dpung shed btsan dbang byed babs la gzhigs na de lan de 'jal mi gnang mthu med kyang / rgya gar dbyin gzhung nas 'dzin skabs phan tshun mthun lam gnas mus ma zad/ da lam de phyogs rgya gar gzhung gi dpon rigs don ma go re zung gis gnas dus tshod rtsis lta bu'i dkrog rkyen byung ba zhig las/ rgya gar gzhung gi bka' dang 'brel min ma nges pa bcas bod sa bston med mon gyi khongs gtogs sa mtshams su gsar spros ham bzung mi 'byung ba'i sngar sa da 'jags yong thabs mthun lam gang zab dgos rgyu dang / sa mtshams rdzong sdod mi sna re zung thog rgya gar gzhung nas gnas dus tshod rtsis dpung shed byed babs 'di dbang mi 'gro ba'i byes kyi gro mo bka' shag nas rgya gar gzhung la bka' mol gnang dgos zhu gnas sngon phul zin gshis phebs gsal dang bstun byed bde'i bkod rgya 'phral du btang 'thus song na de don bka' mol gyis bka' gsal yod pa zhes btang ba red/ de lan gro mo bka' shag nas lha sa bka' shag la spyi lo 1951bod lcags yos zla 3 tshes 17la btang yig nang rgya gar gzhung nas rang khongs mon rta dbang khul gyi sa rigs za sems gsar spros skor rgya gar ba'i gro mo tshong spyi bsod stobs brgyud bod gzhung phyi rgyal las khungs nas gros mol nan tan byas par nye lam rgya gar gzhung gi bka' 'khor tshul zhu babs tshig tho'i nang mon rta dbang man shing stag sim la'i chings yig la rgya gar khongs gsal bas bdag sprod byas nges las gnas dus tshod rtsis min tshul gang ltar rgya gar bas bdag sprod byed rkyang las phyir sprod byed rtsis mi 'dug pa de dag bod sa bston med la 21

brten rang bzhin spyi zom 'jog thabs med rung / deng skabs rgya bod zhi 'phros gnang mus la brten mon skor rgya gar gzhung la lam seng bka' mol gnang ba legs sam/ rgya bod zhi 'phros ma grub bar ngang 'then gnang rgyu ji legs dgongs bzhes gnang dgos zhes btang 'dug par brten gros mthun bzhag ma grub bar ngang 'then byas pa red/7 nga rang sger gyi 'dzin dbang yang gyin rdus ham bzung byas pa ni/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gcig pa'i yang srid sku phreng bcu gnyis pa spyi lo 1868bod sa rta lor ngos 'dzin thugs gtan 'khel rjes yab yum dang sku mched sras sros bzhugs yul yab gzhis dgos stabs sa gnas srid gzhung nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa'i yab gzhis lha klur zla bsgril gtong rgyur thugs gtan 'khel te tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i yab gzhis gnyis zla bsgril zhing / skabs der tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa'i yab yum sras sros kyi sku skal mtshon byed yab gzhis 'khyongs bsdon du kong po sgar chags gzhis dang / de'i le lag sbas chags sbyi sogs kyi 'dzin dbang sa khang mi gsum ri klung bdag thob bcas sa gnas srid gzhung gis gtan tshig yig rigs dang sbrags ji srid bar lha klur gnang tshun nas spyi lo 1951lo bar khrul bsdu khrims gnon tshang ma nga tshos byed bzhin pa yin rung / gong lo'i zla 10nang sbas chags sbyir glo bur du hin rdu'i dpon rigs dang / dmag mi/ do po dbor mi/ thad 'phur gnam gru gcig bcas yong ste sbas chags sbyir btsan 'dzul gyis sa mi yongs rdzogs hin rdus ham 'phrog byas song / me khe ma hung sa thig zhes pa ni dbyin gos lkog g.yo ngan jus kyis bzos pa zhig yin cing / lhag par krung dbyang gi sku tshab med par dbyin bod sku tshab gnyis nas lkog tu yi ge brje res byas pa'i khrims 'gal gyi bya ba zhig yin tsang khungs 'khyol nus pa gang yang med 22

pa ma zad/ sa thig der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'gan 'dzi khas len rtsa ba nas byas med gshis/ da cha nyin rdus btsan b.ri yongs rdzogs smos ci/ btsan bzung byas pa nas bzung da bar :'bab rnams kyang nges par du phyir slog dgos kyi 'dug

hin rdu btsan 'dzul dmag gis mon khul du btsan 'dzul byas pa'i don dngos/thub bstan chos 'phel/1951lor rgya gar bas rang rgyal gyi mnga' khongs mon rta dbang khul du btsan 'dzul byed skabs rang nyid bka' shag gi bkod mngags ltar mon rta dbang dgon gyi bla gnyer byed sgang yin pas lo rgyus dus mtshams de'i mi dpang gi gras shig yin/sa glang(1949)lo stag lung brag gis bod kyi srid skyong byed skabs nga rang rgyal rtse dpal chos mkhan 'dzin byed mur rtse yig tshang las khungs nas bka' bsgyur yig chung 'byor gsal‘‘mon rta dbang gnyer tshang thab 'dzin mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas mon rta dbang de bzhin rgya 'brug sa mtshams gal cher nga rang yig tshang las khungs su gtan sdod zhu dgos kyis rkyen pas sa gnas su thab 'dzin mkhan drung gong ma rim pa'i lam ltar ngo tshab bam bog mar btang ste 'jog rgyu de dag 'gan blos bzod min la thab rten go brjes dang 'brel rta gnyer las 'dzin mkhan drung gi thab rten la ma chod gong de snga gzhung zhabs ngo ma 'gro lam bzhin mi 'gro bsko rdzong yong ba zhes zhus don da nas bzung sa mtshams gal cher de snga'i lam ltar gzhung zhabs mi 'gro bsko gtong mdzad rgyu thugs lha4

gtan 'khel don khyed rang rgyal rtse dpal chos mkhan 'dzin rtsi drung thub bstan chos 'phel la gnas drug pa mon rta dbang gnyer tshang las 'dzin gnas spo bsko gzhag rtsal song bas bka' bsgyur mjal dar 'phral 'bul gyis sprod lam zhus nas sa gnas su las 'khur brtsis len byed par 'phral thon dgos rgyu’miphebs don bzhin nga rang rgyal rtse nas lha sar bka' bsgyur mjal dar 'bul bar bcar te sprod lam zhus nas mon rta dbang gnyer tshang las 'dzin rtsis len byed par nga rang ngo ma 'phral du 'gro rtsis yin rung / skabs der rgyal rtse dpal chos mkhan 'dzin gsar pa bsko gzhag ma gnang stabs dpal chos las 'khur rtsis sprod bya rgyu dang / rta gnyer las 'khur rtsis len bya rgyu gnyis 'doms rkyecha/ sngon la mon rta dbang gnyer tshang las 'dzin rtsis mtshams gzhir bzung brtsis len byed par ngo tshab gcung po rgyal mtshan brtson 'grus dang / rogs rngasto ra dpal chos dgon gyi grwa bstan dar zer ba gnyis btang zhing / lcags stag(1960)lo bod zla 5nang nga rang ngo ma mon rta dbang dgon du gnyer tshang gi 'gan bab las don byed par thog mar4 bskyod(de skabal g.yog po chos 'phel dang / don yod/ dgra 'dul/ phun rab/ o chung bcas dang / sngon btang gcung po rgyal mtshan brtson 'grus dang / bstan dar bcas nga tsho ngo g.yog brgyad yod pa nas chos 'phel dang don yod gnyis mon du sdod skabs 'das grongs song zhing /bstan dar dang o chung gnyis rta dbang zhol du skye dman dang kha thug ste rta dbang du bsdad song)cing / sbom la brgyab nas nags tshal 'go tshugs kyi 'dug la de nyin rta dbang du'ang 'byor gyi 'dug dus skabs ni dbyar stod yin pas ljon shing lo ma rgyas pa dang / stag ma sogs kyi me tog sna tshogs bzhad 'dug de nyin rta dbang grwa tshang nas lam thag spyi le gnyis lhag tsam sar thab bsu'i lding gur yol sgor rang 'grigs bab lte pan 'brug shing lo me tog gi rgyan spros can 25

zhig phub pa de'i nang go bab kyi gdan lcog brgyab 'dug pa der 'khong 'phral ja 'bras sogs kyi bza' btung bshams shing / rta dbang dgon gyi bla ma las sne nas 'tshams 'dri'i kha btags sne sprod byas rjes rta hrag bang sgrig gis bskyod de rta dbang dgon gnyer tshang du 'byor skabs grwa tshang yang steng nas dung dang rgya gling gi bsu sna sogs rta dbang gnyer tshang gzhung zhabs mi 'gro ngo ma sa gnas su 'byor dus ltar gyi sngar srol gzab rgyas gang yod byed kyi 'dug de nas rta dbang gnyer tshang du 'byor rjes bla brang dang / grwa tshang gi las sne/ ze la tshun chod shar nyi ma tsho gsum(shar tsho gcig lha'u tsho gnyis/ bse ru tsho gsum)dang / nub dwags pa tsho brgyad(mu khob shag gsum tsho gcig bzang lung tsho gnyis/ kha bong tsho gsum/ khri lam tsho bzhi/ mthong len tsho lnga/ padma mkhar tsho drug 'ung la tsho bdun/ sag bkras tsho brgyad)spang chen lding drug(spang chen shog tshan lding la bar lding ngam gnas skor lding gcig spang chen shog tshan stod lding gnyis/ smad lding gsum/ klu 'bum lding bzhi/ spang chen rmya chos lding lnga/la rtse mkhan sman lding drug)legs po tsho bzhi(srin mo tsho gcig gom ri tsho gnyis/ skyid pa tsho gsum/ zhan slang tsho bzhi)bcas kyi yul tsho so so'i gtso rgan dang / zhal ngo(lding dpon yang zer)rnams rim par yong nas mjal zhu yin zhes kha btags dang / de min mon pa'i ras lte re dang / ja chang /dngos rigs bcas 'khyer nas yong gi 'dug de bzhin de snga tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs yul mon o rgyan gling du yin pas khong gi khyim tshang dang / sa zhing / khang dngos bcas khong gi a khu'i mi rgyud kyis bdag gir byas chog pa dang / phyi nang gi khrul rigs chag yang gnang ba'i sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sogs rim brgyud nas bstsal ba'i bka' gtan mig ston dang 'brel kha btags dang dngos rigs 'khyer te sgrub chag zhu bar yong 26

srol 'dug pa ma zad/ mon dzāgs pa tsho brgyad kyi zhal ngos kyang tā la'i bla ma lnga pa mchog dang sde pa gzhung gis gnang ba'i bka' gtan 'khyer yong nas gong dang mtshungs pa'i sgrub chag zhu bar yong srol ltar slebs byung /rta dbang dgon pa dang / chos lugs skor/ rta ngabang dgon pa ni tā la'i bla ma lnga pa mchog nas khong gi slob ma me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho 'khrungs yul mon 'brug sa mtshams me rag sag steng nas yin par brten ched mngags gtong gnang mdzad pa ltar me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtshos rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags smrel(1680)lor phyag btab ste dgon ming la rta dbang dga' ldan rnam rgyal lha rtse zhes yongs su grags shing /'di ni 'bras spungs blo gling grwa tshang gi dgon lag yin pas rta dgon mkhan po blo gling grwa tshang nas bsko rdzong byed pa ma zad/ rtse yig tshang las khungs kyi dgon deb nang du'ang rta dbang dga' ldan rnam rgyal lha rtse zhes 'khod pa ltar bod khongs dge lugs pa'i gzhis dgon che gras shig yin la/ des mtha' mtshams kyi bdag dbang spung skyong yang byed cing / tā la'i bla ma lnga pa mchog dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rta dbang dgon par she bam dang / gtan tshig rim par gnang ba'i dmigs bsal dbang cha khag 'khod pa'i nang tshan gcig ni bu gsum bar pa'i btsun khrul zhes pa bsdus chog pa'i gtan 'bebs yod gshis rta dbang dgon par grwa grangs 'phar chag med pa grangs tshad lnga brgya tham pa tag tag dgos kyi 'dug dgon pa'i rten gyi gtso bo ni sku tshab sde lnga'i sku gcig dang / tā la'i bla ma lnga pa rang gi shangs mtshal las 'bri gnang mdzad pa zhes pa'i dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i zhal thang gcig yod pa de gnyis ni tā la'i 27

bla ma lnga pahaṃmachog nas me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtshor byas rjes gzengs bstod la gnang ba red zer rgyun dang / gzhan yang gser zangs las grub pa'i thub dbang gi sku bsnyan thog rtsegs gnyis tsam byas pa sogs sku gsung thugs rten bsam yul las 'das pa yod pa'i mon khul gyi dgon pa che shos shig yin/mon yul gyi srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi'i skor/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho dang / mtsho sna'i lding dngo na nam mkha' 'brug grags gnyis la bka' phab pa ltar mon yul du srid dbang dngos su btsugs pa ste srid 'dzin lte ba rta dbang bzhi sbrel zhes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bsko gzhag byas pa'i rta dbang gnyer tshang ser skya gnyis dang / 'bras spungs blo gling grwa tshang gis bsko gzhag byas pa'i rta dbang dgon gyi mkhan po/ rta dbang grwa tshang gi bla ma las sne bcas phyogs bzhi las grub pa de ni rgyun tshugs srid 'dzin gyi sgrig gzhi red/ des mon yul yongs kyi srid 'dzin bya bar thad kar do dam byed kyi yod/ rta dbang drug sbrel zhes pa ni gong gi bzhi sbrel thog la bod sa gnal srid gzhung gis bsko gzhag byas pa'i mtsho sna rdzong ser skya gnyis bsnan pa'i phyogs drug las tshugs pa zhig yin/ bzhi sbrel dang / drug sbrel nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' rgya 'byor dus skabs 'phral so sor seng ge rdzong dang / rdi rang rdzong / stag lung rdzong / rgyang mkhar rdzong bcas rdzong khag bzhi dang / yul tsho so so'i gtso rgan la brda sprod dang /gyod gzhi byung tshe bcad khru btang ste gyod thag gcod pa sogs byed pa'i dbang cha cha tshang yod/ rta dbang bdun sbrel zhes pa ni drug sbrel thog la bla phyag las khungs kyis bsko gzhag byas pa'i mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pa tshong 'grul gyi gnad don dang /28

dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul byung skabs 'tshogs pa dang / dgu sbrel ni bzhi sbrel dang / drug sbrel nas bsko gzhag byas pa'i nyi ma tsho gsum gyi gtso rgan zhuṭa pa de ni gal che'i bya ba byung skabs 'tshogs dgos pa bcas yin/mon rgyang mkhar rdzong dpon mtsho sna rdzong gis bsko bzhag byed pa dang /seng ge rdzong gi rdzong dpon rgyang mkhar rdzong gis gcig spyogs byed pa/ rdi rang rdzong dpon dang / stag lung rdzong dpon gnyis rta dbang bla grwa tshogs 'dus mi 'gro rang khungs las sne'i khongs nas bsko gzhag byed pa/ nyi ma tsho gsum gyi gtso rgan sogs tsho khag des rta dbang bzhi sbrel lam/ drug sbrel la ming tho sprad nas chog mchan thob dgos pa/ de min tsho dang lding khag gi gtso rgan rnams ni tsho khag so sos rta dbang bzhi sbrel dang / drug sbrel gyi khrul bsdu'i ngo tshab bam/rdzong khag bzhi'i rdzong sdod la ming tho sprud de bsko gzhag byed pa bcas sgrig srol de dag gis so so'i khyab khongs nang 'gan dbang lag bstar byed phyogs thad dper na nga rang rta dbang gnyer tshang las 'dzin byed skabs ze la tshun chod nang gi shar nyi ma tsho gsum dang / nub dwags pa tsho brgyad/ spang chen lding drugalegs po tsho bzhi sogs la khrul bsdu khrims gnon sngar rgyun gzhir bzhag byas thog khrims gtug byed mkhan la gyod gzhi thag gcod byas pa'ang mang po yod ri cing / de'ang dper na lha'u tsho khongs dpa' bo gdung ngag dbang zer ba dang /gnyer pa kha'u zer ba gnyis sa zhing skor mtsho sna rdzong la gyod gtug thag gcod ma thub par rta dbang bzhi sbrel la zhu gtug byas song khar dpyad khru btang ste gyod gzhi thag gcod byas pa dang / de bzhin byang yul chen mo'i gtso rgan gsar pa mkha' 'gro zer bar bsko gzhag byas pa sogs lta bu red/skyu9

mon yul gyi gtong sgo dang / khral bsdu/ sa gla bcas kyi skor/rta dbang gnyer tshang gi gtong deb nang gsal rta dgon gyi 'char can zhogs tshogs la rgyun ja dang / grwa rer zla phogs 'bru khal re/ chos thog dang /gsang 'dus 'jigs byed kyi sgrub mchod so so/ dga' ldan bzhi mchod dang lnga mchod/ dgu gtor/ lo gsum re'i mtshams ma ṇi dung sgrub tshugs dus bcas la ja thug dang / tshwa grwa rtsam pa sogs gtong sgo 'phar ma gtong dgos pa dang /de 'brel rta dbang dgon pa'i khongs gtogs rgyang gong btsun ma'i dgon par btsun ma bzhi bcu skor la zla phogs grwa pa dang gcig mtshungs 'bru khal re sprod dgos pa bcas gong gsal mchod rgyun gtong dmigs rta dbang gnyer tshang gi bsdu deb nang gsal mon khul gyi tsho lding sum cu so gnyis khongs shar nyi ma tsho gsum dang / sbrang nang / rong nang chu rgyud/ nub dwags pa tsho brgyad bcas sa gnas khag so so nas lo ltar khrul bsdu byed dgos shing / gnyer tshang gi ngo tshab khrul bsdur ma bskyod gong sa gnas so sor sngon la brda yig thog mtha' bar gsum gtong srol ltar btang ste gzhi nas khrul bsdur bskyod thog sa gnas khrul rkang so so nas lo ltar 'bru rigs dbyar khrul dang / dgun khrul thengs re bsdu gi yod pa dang / bsdus pa'i 'bru de rnams sa tshigs so so brgyud rta dbang gnyer tshang du skyel dgos pa/ de bzhin legs po tsho bzhi dang / spang chen sding drug gi 'brog dud tshang ma'i gnag phyugs gzhon ma re nas 'brog las dpya khrul lo ltar mar nyag dgu re bsdu ba dang / mar dos de rnams legs po tsho bzhis rta dbang gnyer tshang du skyel dgos pa dang / da dung legs po tsho bzhis lo gsum re'i mtshams su rta dbang dgon pa'i 'du khang gi thog pang gsar pa brje 3 0

dgos pa'i khar/ rta dbang gnyer tshang gi bkod tham gzhir bzung 'du /pong gi thog pang nyams gso byed par yang yong dgos/ rta dbang zhol du sdod mkhan gnyer tshang gi mi ser rnams nas nyin ltar gnyer tshang la thab g.yog mi re 'khor res byas te rgyugs dgos shing / shing bya(1945)lo rta dbang gnyer tshang gong ma'i dus dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas krung go'i bod kyi mnga' khongs bston med mon shar ze la man chod du btsan 'dzul ham bzung byas te seng ge rdzong dang / rdi rang rdzong / stag lung rdzong bcas khag gsum la rdzong dpon mi 'gro 'gro yul med pa bzos pa ma zad/ sa khul de dag la rta dbang gnyer tshang dang / bla brang / mtsho sna rdzong bcas kyis khrul bsdu khrims gnon yang bya yul med pa bzos stabs nga rang rta dbang gnyer tshang gi las 'dzin du 'byor skabs mon shar ze la man chod sbrang nang dang / rong nang / chu rgyud sogs la sngar lam khrul bsdu khrims gnon bya yul med pa dang / de bzhin de snga rta dbang gnyer tshang gi do dam bya khongs yin pa hin rdu'i a sam gyi nye 'dabs su yod pa'i a 'bar ta la zer ba'i sa cha de dbyin jis rgya gar dbang bsgyur byed skabs bod nas dbyin jis bogs mar btang bar lo rer sa gla dbyin ji'i sgor mo chig stong tham pa re sprod len byed pa de dag sprod len byed sa mon yul gyi sa'i char gtoṭa pa'i a 'bar ta lar yin bas lo ltar rta dbang gnyer tshang gi ngo tshab sa gla len par bskyod skabs rta gnyer la bka' shag nas gtan 'beb byas pa'i gtan 'jags lam yig gcig sprad yod pa de'i nang‘ lha sa nas dmigs bsal rgod la brgyud/ a 'bar ta la phyin gyi lam 'khel rdzong gzhis rgan dmangs rnams nas nges dgos/ rta dbang gnyer tshang 'di par rta thab gzan shing dang / dos rta skul gtong / ko gru'i sgol 'don sogs sngar lam gang yod 'phral sgrub byed dgos’’zhes 'khod pa'i gtan lam de 'khyer nas lo ltar bod zla 11pa'i nang a gi1

'bar ta lar rgya che'i tshong dus shig tshogs kyi yod pa de dus sa gla sprod len byed kyi yod cing / sa gla'i dngul 'bab nas dbyin sgor lnga brgya tham pa bka' shag la 'bul gyi yod pa dang / dbyin sgor lnga brgya tham pa rta dbang dgon sogs la 'bab pa de dag dbyin jis rgya gar dbang 'dzin skabs me khyi(1946)lo bar sprod mus yin pa de ni rta dbang gnyer tshang rnying pa mkhan drung ngag rnam gyi ngo tshab bogs len blo bzang rnam rgyal nas kyang len myong yod lugs blo rnam gyi bu rgan pa e rgyan bsta na 'dzin nas brjod 'dug me phag(1947)lo hin rdu rang btsan byung ba nas bzung sa gla de dag sprod mtshams bzhag par brten nga rang rta dbang gnyere cha nga las 'dzin byed skabs sa gla len yul med pa chag zin 'dugamon yul gyi dngul dang / yi ge goms gzhis skor/mon yul 'gro rgyugs byed pa'i dngul ni bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis par 'debs byas pa'i ṭam ka dkar po sprod len byed pa ma zad/ rtsis stangs kyang bod kyi sa khul byings dang 'dra ba skar phyed gsum/ skar lnga/ skar phyed brgyad/ zho gang / ṭam ka srang gang / rdo tshad sogs rtsis srol gcig pa red/yi ge ni bod yig kho na ma gtogs mon rigs la yi ge zur du med cing / bod yig slob sbyong byed stangs thad la'ang sum rtags slob khrid byed pa sogs bod dang gcig mtshungs yin pa dang / bod kyi lo tho bed spyod byas nas gza' skar brtsi ba/ gshin rtsis bskor ba/ bod lugs sman dpyad byed pa/ phyogs mtshungs sto za stangs dang gos gyon stangs sogs gang ci bod rigs 'dra mtshungs red/mtsho sna rdzong dang / rta dbang gnyer tshang nas brda yig dang / skul tham gtong 3lha

skobs mi ge dbu can bris te gtong srol 'dug nga rang rta dbang gnyer tshang du 'byor te sdod yun dus thung nang shar ze la tshun chod dus bde zhod 'jags yin la ser skya mi dmangs kyi nang nas sprang po zer ba'i lto slong mkhan yang gcig kyang med par mi dmangs rnams blo bde bag phebs ngang rang mkho rang ldeng gi 'tsho bar longs su spyod bzhin pa red/mon rta dbang khul du hin ju dpon dmag lhags 'byor dang gin zus gcung bu do dam brtson 'jug byas skor/me phag(1947)lo hin rdu rang btsan byung rjes gyin rdus mon gyi sa khongs sbom steng la'i sgang la dbyin ji'i skabs bzhin sa srung 'go dmag bzhag pa'i dmag sgar de nas nyin rdu'i 'go dmag brgya skor zhig rta dbang du sim 'dzul byed par yong gtan 'khel lugs sbor gtam thos ma thag de 'phral nga rang nas lam seng lha sar bka' shag la sbom steng lar yod pa'i hin rdu'i sa spung dmag sgar de nas 'go dmag brgya skor zhig rta dbang du zos lo kha brnyogs kyis sim 'dzul byed par yong gtan 'khel 'dug pa de dag 'gog thabs nyin rdu srid gzhung la zhi ba'i bka' mol gnang nas 'thus na las/ de min rang sa gzhan shor mi 'byung ched drag po dpung gi 'gog thabs gnang 'os sogs gang 'gab dgongs bzhes dang 'brel 'di gar byed bde'i bka' gsal yod pa zhes snyan zhu 'bul bar bang mi ched btang la bka' shag nas phyir lan bka' rgya'i nang gal te gyin rdu'i 'go dmag 'byor tshe snga 'phros zhi 'jam blo khrid kyi sgo nas mthun lam byas te pha rol po'i spyod 'gros cho bab ji byed lta rtogs kyis gnas tshul 33

sgyun bsrings yod pa nas/ zhib pa phyi 'brel las khungs brgyud gyin rdu srid gzhung la bka' mol gnang rgyur de gar khyod tsho'i khrul bsdu khrims gnon gyi byed sgo sngar rgyun bzhin byed dgos zhes phebs byung zhing / de nas lcags yos (1951)lo'i bod zla 1tshes 3 nyin nyin rdu'i dpon dmag brgya skor zhig dang /dos skyel ze la man chod kyi mi ser mang po khrid de rta dbang du slebs byung ba de nyin thog mar yong dus hin rdu'i dpon rigs me car zer ba(klo mon gnyis kyi 'go byed mkhan red zer skad)gcig dang / em rje'i 'go pa keb kran zer ba gcig de min 'go dmag bzhi bcu skor zhig bcas 'byor song ba de dag sngon la gzhung lam nas ri rtse 'grims te rta dbang dgon pa'i shar ngos spungs steng zer ba'i ri'i sgang nas bab ste yong thog rta dbang zhol gyi gsham spang steng du gur phub ste bsdad song ba de nas gzhung lam brgyud 'go dmag drug cu tsam dang / dos skyel mi ser rnams rim bzhin 'byor song / dgong dro dmag sgar chags pa yin zer ba'i mtshon brda dmag dung gtong gi 'dug de'i sang zhoṭa nga rang nyin rdu'i 'go dmag sar gnas lugs ji zer lta bar thug 'phrad yin khul ja chang dang / shing 'bras 'khyer nas phyin pa yin/ de nyin mtsho sna rdzong dga' ldan bla spyi'i ngo tshab byang rtse blo bzang chos dbang dang / rdzong ya shod drung rdo grong tshe ring rdo rje'i ngo tshab rgyang mkhar rdzong sdod blo bzang / mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pa'i ngo tshab thub bstan/ 'bras blo gling grwa tshang gi rta dbang mkhan po'i ngo tshab dga' ldan ser kong phyag mdzod/ rta dbang grwa tshang gi slob dpon las sne bcas dang / mon shar nyi ma tsho gsum dang / nub dwags pa tsho brgyad/ spang chen lding drug bcas kyi gtso rgan yang mang che ba rim bzhin slebs song ba kho tshos kyang hin rdu'i dpon rigs la sprod byed ja chang dang / shing 'bras sogs 'khyer 'dug dgong dro nga tsho tshang ma 'dzoms dgos zer bas tshang 'dzoms 34

sar dhan rdu'i dmag dpon mi car sab zer ba des gtam bshad byas don nga tsho 'go dmag rnams nyin rdu srid gzhung rdzi/ bka' phab pa ltar 'di gar yong don sna spyi lo 1914bod shing stag lo sim la'i chings gsal me khe ma hung gi sa thig gzhir bzung mtsho sna dang / mon gnyis kyi dbar yod sbom la man gyi sa khang mi gsum bod gzhung nas dbyin jir sprad pa zhig red/ spyi lo1947lo nga tsho nyin rdu ba dbyin ji'i btsan gnon 'og nas sger langs rang dbang rang btsan byung ste dbyin ji'i skabs kyi 'dzin dbang bdag thob tshang ma nga tsho nyin rdu srid gzhung la yod gshis/ des na deng skabs chab mdo sa khul du rgya mi gung khrun mang po slebs yod stabs nga tsho'i sbom la man gyi sa khang mi gsum bdag bzung sprod par yong ba yin/ de 'dra song tsang nyi ma sang nyin nas bzung mtsho sna rdzong dang 'bras khang gnyis nas mi ser thog khrul bsdu khrims gnon gyi byed sgo khyas na chog gi ma red/ de bzhin rta dbang gnyer tshang gis kyang dgon pa'i gtong sgo mi ser sa nas sngar lam bsdus te dgon par gtong sgo gtong rgyu'i thad la lugs dang mthun pa'i sgo nas sha khu sha thim btang ste nyin rdu srid gzhung gi khrims 'khur byas nas bsdad na 'grig gi red/ de min sngar bzhin mi ser thog khrims gnon byed sgo dang / nam rgyun ba dayog skul 'ded/ khrul bsdus te sbom la sgrol nas lha sar skyel 'dren byed pa'i rigs nam yang byas mi chog yul tsho so so'i gtso rgan rnams nas kyang gnyer tshang gis dgon pa rang la gtong sgo gtong byed kyi khral rigs gcig po sprod pa ma gtogs mtsho sna rdzong 'bras gnyis la sngar rgyunatekhrul rigs sne gcig sprad mi chog ces nga tsho tshang ma thun mota thog bshad song bar de 'phral nga rang dang / mtsho sna rdzong ngo ma ngo tshab/ 'bras khang ngo tshab/bla brang ngo tshab/ grwa tshang gi slob dpon las sne bcas nas da lta khyed tshos gang bshad rnams nga tshos mgo skur dang len byed par nga tshor bka' shag nas sim 36

la'i chings gsal sbom la man gyi sa khang mi gsum hin rdu srid gzhung gis rtsis len byed par yong rgyur de mtshams khyed tshos khrul bsdu khrims gnon gyi byed sgo mtshams bzhag ste phyir log yong dgos zhes pa'i bka' nga tsho su la'ang phebs ma byung zhing / lar nas mon yul ni bod kyi mnga' khongs bston med kha 'bral thabs med pa zhig yin par brten nga tshos rang 'tsham gyis khyed tsho'i gang brjod dang len bya thabs bral bas 'di skor bka' shag la dgongs skor snyan zhu zhu rgyur bka' lan ma phebs par nga tsho so so'i khrul bsdu khrims gnon gyi byed sgo sngar rgyun gzhi bzhag bya rgyu yin zhes bshad par nyin rdu'i dpon rigs nas bka' shag la snyan zhu gtong min khyod rang tshos shes kyi red/ shing stag sim la'i chings gsal me khe ma hung gi sa thig gzhi bzung sbom la man gyi sa khang mi gsum gyi khrims 'doms thad nga lam hin rdu srid gzhung gis bka' phab zin pa ltar nyi ma sang nyin nas bzung nga tsho nyin rdu srid gzhung gis bya rgyu yin pas khyod tshos khrul bsdu khrims gnon gyi byed sgo nam yang byas mi chog ces khungs med btsan brjod dang 'brel sang nyin de rang la mtsho mon dbar yod sbom la'i la rtse dang / spang chen dang legs po dbar yod char pa zam gdong gnyis so/ sor sa spung dmag mi btsugs te ham bzung byas song bar brten nga rang dang /rdzong 'bras/ bla grwa bcas nas gros bsdur byas mthar hin rdu'i 'go dmag lhaṭa 'byor rnams kyi byed brjod sogs kyi skor gnas lugs zhib phra bkod de hin rdu'i 'go dmag lhags 'byor rnams phyir 'then yong thabs nyin rdu srid gzhung la zhi ba'i bka' mol gnang yang nus pa thon gyi med tshe da lta gnas tshul gsar thon 'dir drag po'i mthar sgrod cig rang nges par gtong gnang yong ba zhu rgyu dang / nga tshor yang zhu bde'i slob ston yod pa zhes lha sar rgyal blon mtshan 'khod kyi snyan zhu phul ba'i bka' lan du de gar lhags 'byor hin rdu'i dpon 36

rigs la zhi 'jam gyi sgo nas mthun lam gang che byas te khyod tshos khrul bsdu khrims gnon sngar rgyun bzhin byas thog pha rol po'i gnas lugs cho spyod ji byed da mus bzhin gnas tshul rgyun bsrings dgos pa dang / nyin rdu srid gzhung la 'di nas phyi 'brel las khungs brgyud de gar lhags 'byor nyin rdu'i 'go dmag rnams phyir 'byen byed dgos pa'i skor bka' mol gnang mus yin zhes sogs nang don sngon btang bka' spyo dang phyogs mtshungs shig spel 'byor byung zhing /nyin rdu 'go dmag mon du lhags 'byor byung rjes yul lung bde 'jags med pa'i zang zing gi rnam par gyur te mi dmangs rnams bde ba'i go skabs shor rkyen mon yul gyi ser skya mi dmangs rnams nyin rdu'i srid gzhung gi 'og sdod 'dod rtsa ba nas med par khong tshos nga tsho mon pa rnams sngar nas bod rang gi khongs gtogs bston med la brten gang ltar yang snying bod gzhung gis hin rdu btsan 'dzul pa dus tshod snga phyir ma bstos par mthar sgrod btang ste sngar sa sngar gnas yong gi yod kyi red ces zhod pa sogs mon yul ser skya mi dmangs tshang ma hin rdu'i 'og sdod ma dgos pa'i re ba skom pa chu 'dod ltar byed mkhan sha stag red/gyin rdu dpon dmag rta dbang du 'byor nas nyin ma gsum pa'i nyin me car zer ba dang / keb kran ther ba/ de min dmag mi'i 'go byed me mda' thung mda' 'khyer ba gcig dang me mda' sbag sbag 'khyer ba'i dmag mi gsum/skad sgyur bcas nga rang sar thug 'phrad la slebs byung ba lag rtags yin ces a rag shel dam dang / shing tog lcags kring / yang man dang / 'bras sogs sprad nas me car zer ba des da lam tshang 'dzoms sar bshad zin pa ltar khyed rang gis rta gnyer bsdu gtong byed sgo sngar rgyun gzhi bzhag bzhin byas na 'grig gi red/ nga tsho nyin rdu srid gzhung gis ring min 'di gar slob grwa zhig 'dzugs rgyur bod yig slob 'khrid thog khyed nas rogs ram byed rogs/ phogs thob 37

thad gun med sprod kyi yin ces zer zhing / de skabs nyen srung dmagre/ mi me mda' sbag sbag 'khyer ba gsum po sgo 'gram du yar mar phyin nas lta rtogs byas te dogs zon ha cang chen po byed kyi 'dug de bzhin rta dbang grwa tshang dang yul tsho so so'i gtso rgan la'ang mgo bskor blu brid kyi blo 'gug thabs lag rtags 'dra min sna tshogs sprad 'dug cing / de nas nyin shas song mtshams nyin rdu'i dpon dmag rnams rta dbang dgon pa'i shar ngos spungs steng zhes par sgar spos te der dmag sgar lte ba chags thog kho pa tshos mtsho sna rdzong ngo ma ngo tshab dang /nga rang / bla brang ngo tshab/ 'bras khang ngo tshab/ grwa tshang las sne/ yul so so'i gtso rgan bcas la gsol tshigs gtong gi yin ces nga tsho tshang ma mgron 'bod byas byung / de ni kho pa tsho'i mgo skor g.yo sgyu'i bya thabs yin pa nga tshos gsal po shes kyi yod kyang kho pa tshos skad cha ji zer nyams tshod byed phyir nga tshos mgron du phyin pa yin/ 'on kyang de nyin nyin rdu'i dmag mis 'khrub ston byas te ltad mo zhig bstan pa las/ sa mtshams skor sogs la skad cha gang yang bshad ma song / nyin rdu'i dpon rigs kyis sbom la'i la rtse dang / char pa zam gdong man chod la khrims 'doms dbang cha bzung stabs mi ser gyi lag nas dgon pa'i gtong khrul 'bru mar sogs ji bzhin bsdu len ma thub par brten rta dgon gyi gtong sgo gtong dka' ba ma zad/ mon yul ni krung go'i bod kyi sa khongs bston med la brten sngar sa sngar gnas yong rel snga 'phros rta gnyer gyi bsdu gtong byed mi ngo tshab gcung bu rgyal mtshan brtson 'grus bzhag ste nga rang nyin rdu dpon dmag gi snga bar phyi gsum gyi gnas lugs yong rkyen slar yang snyan bskul zhu bar lha sar 'gro rtsis kyis hin rdu'i dpon rigs sar bskyod de gtong jar kha g.yar nas gtong ja rdzogs mtshams la thug pas gtong ja nyo sgrub byed par nga rang mtsho snar bdun pa'i tshong 'dus la 'gro rgyur de'i ring 38

gnyer tshang gi bsdu gtong byed mkhan rngo tshab gcung bu rgyal mtshan brtson 'grus 'jog rgyur mi ser la gtong khrul sngar lam bzhin sprod dgos bkod khyab yod pa dang / sbom la'i sgang yod pa'i sa srung dmag mis 'grul pa'i dngos rigs sngog bsher byed kyi 'dug pas nga'i dngos po sngog bsher byed ma dgos pa zhes brjod pa yin/ lha sar yong khar gcung por nyin rdu'i dpon dmag nas bya spyod ji byed gsang ba'i sgo nas lta rtogs zhib nan byas te gsang gnas chu yig 'bri stangs bslab nas chu yig de dag khams bde'i gnas tshul yin khul gyi yi ge dang chabs cig yig skogs nang blugs nas yang yang gtong dgos zhes mngags cha byas thog rta dbang gnyer tshang gi gtan tshigs she bam dang / bsdu gtong gi deb yiga.am par ta la'i sa gla am par ta lar len par 'gro dus kyi gtan lam sogs gtso bo'i yig rigs gang na ji yod rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa 'khyer nas lha sar yong te gtan tshigs yig rigs rnams bka' shag la bka' drung sman skyid gling pa brgyud phul thog bka' shag dang / phyi 'brel las khungs su krung dbyang gi sku tshab yang gung su'u dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa bcas la mon rta dbang du glo bur lhags 'byor nyin rdu'i dpon dmag gi snga bar phyi gsum gyi gnas lugs rnams zhib phra snyan seng dang 'brel mon yul ni krung go'i bod kyi mnga' khongs bston med la song tsang nyin rdu btsan 'dzul pa 'phral du phyir 'then yong thabs zhi drag thabs sgo mdzad 'os ji 'gab dgongs bzhes kyis don snying rang sa gzhan shor ma song ba rang gzugs rang bdag sngar rgyun gzhir bzhag yong ba zhes nyin bstud zhu mur/ mon rta dbang nas gcung bus kyang mngags cha byas don bzhin hin rdu'i dpon rigs kyis mi ser sgo them re'i sa nas them khrul gyin rdu'i ru pi(kha grangs nges gsal zhu yas mi 'dug)bsdus te mi dmangs rnams sdod bzod mi bde ba bzo yi yod lu gas 39

dang / gnam gru nyin ltar yong nas rdzas mdel dang bza' bca' sogs gnam gru'i nang nas g.yugs kyi yod lugs/ sbom la'i la rtse dang / char pa zam gdong la sa srung dmag mi 'phar sdon gtong gi yod lugs sogs kyi gnas tshul yi ge chu yig bris te bskur ba thengs gnyis lag 'byor byung ba'i gnas gsal rnams skabs 'phral so sor bka' shag dang phyi 'brel las khungs su snyan seng zhus pa dang / gnas tshul yi ge gsum pa gtong skabs sbom la'i sgang yod hin rdu'i sa srung 'go dmag gis yi ge zhib bsher zhib tshags byas mthar chu yig yin pa shes te gcung bu gsang ba'i so pa red ces hin rdu'i dmag sgar nas 'dzin bzung do dam btson 'jug byas thog gnyer tshang du yod pa'i dngos rigs gang na ji yod rnams hin rdu'i dpon rigs kyis btsan 'phrog byed skabs gnyer tshang gi gtan tshigs yig rigs rnams nga rang nas lha sar 'khyer te bsdad med pa dang / gtan yig de dag gi nang du krung go'i bod kyi gna' dus sa mtshams skor gsal 'khod yod par brten kho pa tshos de ni rtsa don ha cang gal cher brtsis te nyin rdu'i dpon rigs kyis rta gnyer rtse drung lha lar phyir log 'gro skabs mtsho sna'i tshong 'dus la gtong ja nyo sgrub byed par 'gro yi yin tshul kha g.yar rdzun gtam bshad nas gnyer tshang gi yig rigs rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa tshang ma gsang thabs kyi sgo nas 'khyer te bsdad kyi 'dug ces zer nas khong khro'i me lce 'bar zhing dgra 'dzin chen po byed kyi yod lugs dang / gcung bu nyin rdus 'dzin bzung do dam btson 'jug byed stangs sogs zhib phra skabs der mon rta dbang nas lha sar yong mkhan ngo shes tshang mas don dngos skad cha rtse mthun shod 'dug par brten 'u thug thabs zad kyis bka' shag dang / phyi labrel las khungs su gus pa'i gcung bus gnas tshul yi ge chu yig btang skor rta dbang du sdod pa'i nyin rdu'i dpon dmag gis shes te gcung bu gsang ba'i so 440

pa red ces 'dzin bzung do dam btson 'jug byas thog gnyer tshang du yod pa'i dngos rigs rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa btsan 'phrog byas 'dug pa nyin rdu srid gzhung la mon yul gyi sa mtshams skor bka' mol gnang nas re zhig thag gcod thub pa yong gi med tshe gong du zhus gsal bzhin don rkyen de 'dra zhig gis rkyen bas gcung po 'dzin bzung do dam btson 'jug byas par brten dgongs pa che bzhes kyis gcung bu 'phral la glod 'grol dang 'brel rta dbang gnyer tshang du yod pa'i dngos rigs gyin rdu'i dpon dmag gis btsan 'phrog byas pa rnams phyir slog yong ba'i bka' mol nus thon skyab sa 'jug thugs rje che ba zhes zhus par skabs der krung dbyang nas thugs 'khur gnang ste phyi 'brel las khungs brgyud nyin rdu srid gzhung la bka' mol gnang mthar lo gnyis lhag tsam song rjes gzhi nas nga rang mtsho sna rdzong las 'khur byed skabs/ shing lug(1955)lo'i bod zla 6pa'i nang mon rta dbang nas hin rdu'i 'go dmag gis mtsho sna rdzong la bang mi btang 'byor gyis brjod don rta gnyer ngo tshab rgyal mtshan brtson 'grus btson 'grol gtong rgyur mtsho sna rdzong sbrel sbom la'i sa mtshams su rtsis len byed par yong dgos ze brjod par nga'i bsam blo'i nang nga rang rtsis len byed par phyin tshe nga rang nas de sngon rta gnyer gyi gtan tshigs yig rigs rnams gsang ba'i sgo nas lha sar 'khyer yong bas hin rdu'i dpon rigs nas nga la khong khro dgra 'dzin ha cang chen po byed kyi yod stabs nga rang ma phyin na dga' ba 'dug bsam ste nga rang gi ngo tshab dang / rdzong ya dga' ldan bla spyi'i ngo tshab blo bzang chos dbang gnyis gcung bu rtsis len byed par gtong gtan 'khel zhing / khong gnyis 'gro khar lho kha sa khul rtsed thang nas bcings 'grol dpon dmag kha shas dang / skad bsgyur bcas mtsho snar phebs byung ba khong rnams pas rtsis len byed par rogs ram lu yeng ba yin zhes gsungs te ༈‘snye

sbom la'i sa mtshams kyi nye 'gram du phebs nas rogs skyor mdzad 'og khong gnyis nas sbom la'i sgang gi nyin rdu'i sa srung dmag sgar sar bskyod par gcung bu rgyal mtshan brtson 'grus rtsis len byas pa las/ rta dbang gnyer tshang du yod pa'i dngos rigs gzhung len byas pa rnams sne gcig rtsis sprod byas mi 'dugarang nyid kyi bsam tshul 'ga' zhigamon yul gyi sa mtshams thad la don snying gong du zhib bkod zhus pa ltar gna' dus kyi sa mtshams nyin rdu'i a sam la mtshams bar yin skad go thos yong myong / gang ltar a sam nye 'dabs su yod pa'i a 'bar ta la zer bar sa gla lo rer dbyin sgor chig stong tham pa mon yul gyi sa'i char gtogs pa'i am par ta lar lo ltar bong zla 11pa'i nang sprod len pa'i mus lam byang de dag me khyi(1946)lo bar rta dbang gnyer tshang gong ma mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi ngo tshab bogs len blo bzang rnam rgyal dus bar sprod len byas 'dug pa ma zad/ seng rdi stag gsum la rdzong dpon mi 'gro phyin nas shing sprel( 1944)lo bar shar ze la phan chod sbrang nang tsho drug dang / rong nang tsho bzhi/ chu rgyud bcas la khrul bsdu khrims gnon byed pa dang / mtsho sna rdzong dang rta dbang gnyer tshang nas kyang khrul rigs sne mang bsdu lam yod/ lhag par chu rta(1942)lo bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kha dang byings pa mda' dpon dang / rtse mgron phun rab pa gnyis mon khul du btang ste mon yul yongs rdzogs la 'byed phra zhib gzhung gsar bkod byas yod pa de ni gzhi 'dzin sa'i yig cha khungs rten zhig yin pa ma zad/ sngar nas krung go'i bod kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i mon yul gyi rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma dag khri tsam yod pa'i sa khul thon khungs phun sum tshogs la gzhi rgyu chen po de 'dra zhig skabs der dbyin jis dbang sprur byed pa'i 42

gyin rdu'i sa khongs su bcug pa ni khungs lung spu tsam med pa dang / rbad de khrims 'gal zhig red/ de'i thad la krung go'i srid gzhung rim pas khas len byas med la krung go'i mi dmangs dang / bod mi dmangs rnams kyis kyang ngo rgol byas pa red/ mon yul ni gna' dus nas krung go'i bod kyi mnga' khongs bston med kha bral du mi rung ba'i cha shas mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin par brten dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa'i sku dus nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mon yul yongs su srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi dngos su btsugs pa nas bzung srid 'dzin do dam nus pa ldan pa byas dang byed bzhin yin la/ nga rang la rta dbang gnyer tshang bsko bzhag skabs kyang mon yul gyi khrul bsdu khrims gnon sngar lam byed dgos pa'i bkod khyab gnang ba las/ me khe ma hung sogs kyi gleng sgros tsam gsung mkhan med la nga rang nas go thos kyang yong ma myong /lhag par gyin dmag mon sar lhags 'byor nga rang dang dngos 'phrad skabs kho pa tshos bshang pa'i sa khongs bdag dbang zer ba'i skor khas len bya thabs bral ba'i lan 'debs 'thus nan byas pa ma zad/ sa gnas srid gzhung la bka' 'dri dgongs snyan phul ba'i phyir phebs su'ang nyin rdur 'jam mkhas mthun lam byed dgos pa phud khyab khongs khrul bsdu khrims gnon sngar bzhin byed dgos lugs phebs pa sogs lo rgyus kyi dngos don du ma'i thog nas mon yul 'di bzhin krung go'i bod kyi sa khongs bston med la brten da cha nyin rdu srid gzhung gis lo rgyus kyi dngos don la brtsi 'jog dang / krung hin rgyal khab gnyis po'i mi dmangs dbar gyi srol rgyun gyi mthun lam la bsam gzhigs dang 'brel zhi bde mnyam gnas kyi rtsa don lnga'i dgongs don ltar mdza' grogs kyi 'phrothe mol byed pa brgyud drang bzhag lugs mthun ngang mtha' mtshams kyi gnad don sgo kun nas thag gcod yong ba'i re ba yod/⑫

hin rdu btsan 'dzum dmag la gdong gtugs kyis kha rdung btang ba/mar kong ye shes dgra 'dul/sbas chags shri zhes pa ni sngar mi med lung stong yin pa dang / grub thob thang stong rgyal pos gnas sgo phye ba'i rjes su klo yul dang / kong po dung tsho/kong po stod smad/ mdo smad khul/ e/ 'phan po sogs nas rim gyis mi yong ste lung tsho chags pa'i lo rgyus yod la/ rigs rgyud 'byung khungs la brten nas tshan 'phel zhes brjod srol yod pa ltar da lta'ang de ltar brjod mus yin/dper na/ 'phrin las tshan 'phel zhes pa ni e gong ma khang gsar gyi mi brgyud yin pa dang / nag tshang tshan 'phel zhes pa ni mon rta dbang nas byung ba zhig yin pa/ rgya nag tshan 'phel zhes pa ni chab mdo khul nas yong ba zhig yin pa sogs lung tshan so sor tshan 'phel re yod pa lta bu red/ lung tshan de dag ni gong gsal sa gnas khag nas yong ba'i mis btsugs pa zhig yin pa ha cang gsal po yod/sbas chags shri yul gling bzhi yod cing / sa rgya che la bde 'khod stom pa dang / phu na padma shel phub ces phu'i sa cha zhig nas bla ma'i tshe ril dang 'dra ba'i sa ser po zhig thon pa der zer ba dang / mda' na tshe chang zhes gnas padma byin gling la brag phug gcig nas chu thig babs pa der zer ba/ bar na shel gyi 44

mchod rten zhis shel dkar bum chos zhes pa'i gnas su sngar shel gyi mchod rten byis pa lo brgyad kyi gzugs tshad tsam rang bzhin gyis 'khrungs pa zhig yod zer srol dang / khul de'i g.yas g.yon gang sar shing sna 'dzoms pa'i nags ri bstar chags su yod la/ ri sked spang ljongs yin pa dang / nas dang / 'bras/ma rmos lo tog tsi tse/ mon chags/ si pan/ 'bras sil sogs 'bru rigs sna tshogs skye ba/ lo gsum kham bu dang / lam ka mar khu/ gro ma rta mgo soṭa kyi shing 'bras sna tshogs dang / jo ti nag chung sogs rtsa che'i sman rigs sna tshoṭa kyis mtshon rang byung gi skye dngos ha cang phun sum tshogs po yod/ gzhan yang sgo phyugs mdzo dang / ba phyugs/ ba man/ rtod min/ ra lug phag pa sogs yod la/ stag gzig dom/ skyem nyag phag rgod/ kha sha spra/ spe'u/gdang / ze mo sogs bya dang gcan gzan ri dwags sna tshogs kyang yod pa bcas phun sum tshogs pa'i mdzes ljongs shig yin/kong po sgar chags gzhis ka ni thog mar gzhung 'dzin yin rung / de rjes lha klu tā la sku phreng brgyad pa'i yab gzhis yin mus thog tā la sku phreng bcu gnyis pa'i yab gzhis kyang lha klur zla bsgril btang bas yab gzhis kyi khyongs sgon du gtan tshigs dang / she bam/ khyongs thebs sogs mang pos rgyas bcad de ji srid dbar lha klur kha 'dzin gtan 'jags su sprad pa zhig yin pa dang /sbas chags shri ni sgar gzhis kyi le lag yin gshis phran mar kong ye shes dgra 'dul gyi pha de nyid lha klu'i zhabs khongs la brten chu khyi (1922)lo lha klus sgar chags gzhis sdod bsko gzhag gnang zhing / shing byi(1924)lo 'das grongs ma song bar sgar gzhis las 'dzin byas pa dang / pha 'das rjes ma de nyid nas khrul 'khri'i sgrub sgo ci rigs dgos pa'i thog bu phrug na son gcig kyang med pas gzhis sdod dgongs zhu'i snyan 'bul zhus kyang don son ma byung bar mu mthud lo 46

gnyis gzhi 'dzin rang 'jags byed dgos byung / de rjes me yornga (1927)lo gzhi nas gzhis sdod gsar pa rin spungs rdzong khongs bar grong rgyal po dang sprod dpang 'phyongs rgyas blo bde chu skor gyi bu tog tog btang 'byor byung don sgar chags gzhis rtsis sprod byas pa dang / 'on kyang sgar gzhis lo mjug ma gnyis byed ring gi gzhis 'bab bla phyag las khungs la lo rer mar khal chig stong dang /lha klur shugs bogs mar khal chig stong re 'bul dgos pa de dag gi 'bab chad par lha klu nas sprod dpang tog tog gdong bka' yig phebs don lo gnyis kyi shugs bogs mar khal nyis stong chad pa de dag ka kor med par gtsang 'bul dgos pa'i bka' nan la brten ngos tsho mar kong khyim tshang ni kong khul phyer 'khos rab gras yin pas mi ser gyi lag nas khrul 'bab bsdu len thub min la ma stos par thabs shes sna tshogs kyis gtsang 'bul zhus pa dang / bla phyag las khungs su lo gnyis kyi 'bab chad mar khal nyis stong 'bul dgos thad bka' rgya thengs re 'byor rim la gzhis 'bab de dag mi ser lag nas bsdu rgyur bsdad pa khral deb la gzigs zhib bskyang tshe dgongs dwang yong nges de yang mdzad dka' mchis tshe pha ma de nyid kyi gzhis 'dzin skabs mar khal rer dngul srang do zho lnga re yin pas de ltar dngul bsgyur gyis bzhes cha yong ba zhes snyan zhu thengs re phul te don du lcags yos(1961)lo bar 'bud 'gyangs thub pa byung rung /chu 'brug(1952)lor bla phyag las khungs nas bka' rgya phebs gsal du/ sgar chags gzhis rnying mar kong 'og nas gdan sa gsum gyi gtong thebs 'di ga bla phyag las khungs su gzhis 'bab mar khal nyis lteng tham pa lo mang ring chad 'jog 'bul sems med pa'i ngan sgal byed bab la gzhigs na bkod pa mig lar 'doms pa gcod 'os kyang / da lam yang bzod bgyis te mar khal nyis stong de dag 'di lo'i lo mjug tu gtsang 'bul dgos pa las/ dngul bsgyur 46

ram/ zog jigs/ yang na dus 'gyangs sogs kyi ka kor zhu rigs mchis tshe lus thog chad pa mig lar 'doms pa gcod rgyu dang 'brel mkhar dbang gzhung len bya rgyur rtse la rdzong sdod la bkod rgya gtong rgyu yin zhes phebs byung bas de don tsha 'gan bzod min la brten spun nyi ma nged gnyis nas khrul 'bab bsdu gzhung 'khyer te khrul pa tsho tshan te/ gla mdo dang / bha kha/ bres ma sgang / bam grong / shom kha/ gnas bar/ dga' zhol/ rgya ri 'go bcas kyi sa khul du khrul 'bab bsdu bar bskyod kyang sa gnas mi ser nas gong gsal khrul chad de dag dus yun lo ngo sum cu tsam song bas gzhis sdod rim pa bdun brgyad 'pho len zin gshis 'char 'phar khrul rigs sna tshogs kyis rkyen pas khrul 'dzin mang po zhig ni mi shi khyim stong su gyur pa dang / 'phros bsdad nyung shas tsam las mang che ba nyam thag tu gyur par brten lo mang de tsam song ba'i khrul chad 'bul rgyu lta zhog lo de rang gi khrul 'bab kyang sgrub 'bul dka' zhing / mi ro skam po chu la bskyur nas lo rgan drug cu'i rtsis rgyag gi dpe ltar sgrub thabs bral bar brten bla phyag las khungs su gzhis rnying phran mar kong dang mnyam du bde sdug snyan zhu 'bul dgos zhes brjod pa ltar thun mong nas snyan zhu 'bul rgyu byas po yin/ de rjes gong lo'i zla 10nang spun mched nyi ma nged gnyis dang rogs su rong pa skal bzang dang / bstan pa shes rab/ o rong cog dbang rgyal/ gnas bar pa sangs nor bu bcas khrid de nged tsho mi drug sbas chags shrir khrul bsdur bskyod cing / de skabs smyug la'i la rtser 'byor skabs gnas bar gyar gzhis a dar rin chen dang / gyar gzhis dbang rgyal/ bam brtsegs dgra 'dul bcas thug byung / gyar gzhis rin chen gyis brjod gsal/ nga tsho ni sbas chags shrir snga lo(1951)rgya gar ba mang po slebs pa'i gnas tshul skor 'dri zhib byas par brjod pa yin zhes zer byung / —ngas da ltar rgya gar ba slebs 'dug gam zhes 47
