dris pa'i lan du da lta mi 'dug kyang mgyogs po yong gi yod lugs zer skad 'dug nga tsho nyin dgu bsdad pa de'i ring slebs ma song / khyed tsho yang nyin mang po ma bsdad par gang mgyogs log yong na dga' yi red ces zer gyi 'dugade nas nga tsho bde chen thang du 'byor te khrul 'bab bsdu len byas nas nyin bcu bzhi song nyin zhogs pa nyi ma shar tsam zhig la 'ur sgra chen po grags bzhin 'dug pas phyir thon nas blta skabs sman chu kha zhes pa'i sa gnas su thad phur gnam gru zhig 'phur lding gis bskor ba brgyab rjes sa thog tu babs song ba de'i nang rgya gar ba'i dpon rigs mi grangs drug 'dug pa de rnams chu tshod skar ma kha shas bsdad de phyir log song ba dang dus mtshungs a long sa khul brgyud sgam shas(dos 'khur ba)klo rigs mi grangs drug cu skor dang / rgya gar ba'i dmag mi brgyad cu skor 'byor zhing / de'i sang nyin hin rdus sman chu kha'i nor dpal dang chos dar zer ba gnyis nga tsho'i sar btang ste bod nas yong ba'i khrul bsdu mkhan rnams da lta kho tsho'i(nyin rdu ba)sar yong dgos zhes zer gyi 'dugang tshos de ring khom pa mi 'dug sang nyin slebs yong zhes bshad de khong gnyis phyir slog de'i sang nyin slar yang gyin rdus zhing bar gyi rta dum phur pa dang /sga'u tshal gyi rta phung gnyis btang nas nga tsho shog zer gyi 'dug ces brjod byung /skabs der spun nyi mas nga ni mi 'gro thag chod yin zer zhing / nga dang gnas bar rmo lo pa sangs nor bu gnyis bskyod pa yin/ me mdar rtse gri sgrig pa'i gyin dmag ru nyis sgrigs kyi bar na nged gnyis khrid byung / ru 'gor nyin rdu'i 'go dpon bha rag sab dang / dmag dpon sab/ em rje sab/ glo rigs yin pa'i rda ma sde pa/ skye yul gtsang pa yin pa'i skad sgyur tshe ring zer ba bcas 'dug kho pa tshos rkub stegs steng bsdad de nged gnyis smyug gdan thog tu bzhag thog de 'phral skad sgyur brgyud nga tsho rgya gar di li gsar pa nas yong ba yin zhes 48

brjod pa dang sbrags skad sgyur tshe ring gis rgya gar nas yong ba'i dpon rigs rnams ngo sprod byas rjes khyod tsho 'dir yong dgos don gang yin nam zhes dris byung / de lan ngas nga tsho 'dir khrul bsdu bar yong ba yin zhes bshad/ yang kho tshos sa 'di rgya gar ba'i yin pas khyod tshos khrul bsdu mi chog des ma tshad gtsang chu tshur rgyab lha phyogs tshang ma me mda' dbyin ji'i rin 'bab la sprad tshar ba red ceg zer byung / de 'phral ngas am phrag nang nas bla phyag las khungs kyi bka' rgya de bton thog nga tsho ni dpon po'i bka' nan ma bzod par yong ba zhig yin/ 'di ni nga tsho'i bod gzhung bla phyag las khungs kyi bka' rgya yin pas khyod tshos ltos shig ces bshad pas kho pa tshos bka' rgyar lta nus kyi mi 'dug la/skad sgyur tshe ring gi lag tu sprad kyang len nus kyi mi 'dug pas/ ngas kho pa tsho'i mdun du skad shugs chen pos bka' rgya de thengs gcig klog pa yin/ de 'phral kho pa tshos nged gnyis la zhi 'jam g.yo thabs kyi rnam 'gyur brdzus ma'i thog nas ha yang chung ba gcig dang / ja pa ti shog sgam chung ba gcig ci ṇi shog sgam chung ba gcig tha mag smi ri chags pa drug bcas sprad de khyed tsho bde chen thang gnas tshang du log rogs gnang / nga tshos di lir tar btang nas khyed tshos khrul bsdu chog pa'i lan gsal byung na bsdu chog pa ma zad/ mi dang khrul dngos bcas pa sngar lam bzhin kong po sgar chags bar skyel mkhan btang chog zhes zer byung / de mtshams nged gnyis bde chen thang du phyir log byas/de nas nyin lnga'i thog skad sgyur tshe ring dang nyin dmag bcu skor zhig nga tsho'i sar yong ste khyed tshor me mda' kha shas yod tshod rgya gar gyi khrims lugs la srid gzhung gis ma gtogs me mda' nyar mi chog pas/ de dag gnas skabs nga tshor rtsis sprod byed dgos/ rjes su khyod tsho 'gro khar phyir sprod byas chog ces zer byung bas/ nga tsho nang gros skyus me mda' bzhi yod khongs nas legs pa 49

gnyis nyar te tshab tu gnas tshang nas bod mda' gnyis g.yar te khyon me mda' ngo grangs bzhi sprad pas kho pa tsho phyir log song /yang de nas nyin bcu skor song mtshams skad sgyur tshe ring dang hin dmag bcu skor nga tsho'i sar yong ste khyod tshos mi ser gyi lag nas bsdus zin pa'i khrul dngos rnams mi ser la phyir slog bya rgyu yin pas de ring khyer shog zer byung / de 'phral ngas rgya gar nas tar 'byor byung ngam zhes dris par kho pas/ tar 'byor ma byung yang khyod tsho gnas skabs phyir log mi chog rjes su nga tshos skyel mi btang chog ces zer/ de ni kho pa tshos g.yo rdzun bshad pa las skog tu gnas tshang la nga tsho btang shor mi 'byung ba'i brda btang 'dug skabs der ngas kho pa tshor khral bsdu phyogs skor sde pa gzhung la 'phros mol zhu bar khyod tsho mi gcig yong dgos/gang lags she na/ khyod tshos khrul bsdu rgyur bkag 'gog byas pa las nga tshos ma bsdus pa min/ bsdus zin pa'i khral dngos rnams khyod tshor sprod thabs med/gal te khyod tshos skyel mkhan ma btang na'ang nga tshos mi gla glas te khyer 'gro gi yin zhes bshad par gtam lan ma brgyab par phyir logakhrul bsdu pa rnams sngar lam sgar chags bar mi ser gyis bskyel dgos par brten nga tshos skabs der bsdus pa'i khrul dngos rnams la thel tse brgyab nas khrul khungs so sor rtsis sprod byas yod pa hin rdus shes te nyin zhig skad sgyur tshe ring gis nyin dmag lnga drug tsam khrid de khrul pa so so'i nang du bskyod nas khral dngos phyed ka khral pa so sor phyir sprad pa dang / phyed 'bab gyin rdus 'khyer song lugs mi ser nas lan skyel bar slebs byung / nyin rdus de lta bu'i ham shed brnyad bcos kyi bya ngan byas pa ma zad/ tar lan 'byor ma byung zhes g.yo rdzun bshad de don du nga tsho bros byol song dogs kyis dkar gong la rtser sa srung dmag mi nyi shu skor bzhag pa sogs drag rtsub ngan jus ci rigs kyi sko nas khyon 6pyi

zla ba lnga lhag tsam ring nga tsho bkag skyil byas thog nga tshor bza' cha rdzogs kyang mkho sprod mi byed pa dang / mtshan dgung dmag mi lnga drug tsam nga tsho sdod sa'i 'khor yug tu bskor g.yeng rgyag par btang nas gang byung 'brel gtug 'gro bskyod mi chog pa'i bkag sdom byas pa sogs ni sbas chags shri'i yul mis kyang shes gsal yin/skabs der sbas chags shri'i mthil du sdod pa'i klo rigs grags can rwa mo ling bu zer ba des khong rang gi bu la phag sha phran bu bskur nas nga tsho'i sar gsang stabs kyis btang thog khyod tsho bod nas yong mi rnams bros thabs ma byas na yag po yong bzo mi 'dug go thos la rgya gar bas khyod tsho gung khrun gyi btang ba'i nyul ma yin pas rgya gar du khrid nas btson 'jug bya rgyu yin zhes shod kyi yod tshod 'dug pas de rtsis gang mgyogs bros na dga' gi red/ nga yang ri khug nags gseb tu yibs te rgya gar bar ngo ston gyi med cing / gal te khyod tsho'i sar yong na sri drug cu skor sdod sa yod dam/ nga rang nags khrod nas thar na de phyogs yong gtan yin zer ba'i kha lan yang bskur 'dug par sdod sa yod ces lan bskur ba yin/nga tsho sdod gnas bde chen thang sde pa spen pa'i sar yin pa de ni grong tsho'i dkyil du yin stabs bros thabs dka' bar brten bros bde'i ched du sang nyin der grong tsho'i mtha' la yod pa'i nga tsho'i grogs po bde thang las sbyin gyi nang du spos nas nyin dgu tsam bsdad cing / nga tshos gnas tshang las sbyin la da cha nga tsho bros pa las 'os med gshis khyod kyang mnyam du 'gro na 'tsho ba'i thad nga tshos 'gan len byas chog gal srid 'gro rgyur blo mos meng na nga tsho phyin rjes kyi nyin gnyis gsum tsam la ma gtogs rgya gar bar lan ma skyel/ gal te 'dri mkhan byung na mdang rshab nam ma langs gong tsam la song ba min nam ngas ni shes tshor ma 61

byung zhes shod dgos pa'i mngags cha byas par las sbyin nas nga rang bsdad na rgya gar bas lo mang btson 'jug dang nyes rdung gtong rgyu yin stabs khyed tsho dang mnyam du 'gro gi yin zhes zer don bzhin las sbyin bza' mi gnyis dang phru gu gnyis/ g.yog pho mo gnyis bcas mi drug dang / nga tsho'i skal bzang dang / pa sangs nor bu/ dbang rgyal bcas mi gsum la lam rgyag 'dang tsam bskur te sbas sri bde chen thang nas sa rub mtshams su sngon la btang ba dang / spun nyi ma nged gnyis kyis mi rnams nyal zin mtshams su bde thang shar phyogs dbang rgyal chos dar lam rgyus su khrid nas thon pas nam phyed skabs dkar gong la rtser ma slebs tsam la sngon du btang ba'i mi rnams rjes zin byung / la rtser nyin rdu'i so srung dmag mi yod stabs nyi ma dang / chos dar nged gsum bltar phyin pas nyin dmag rnams me chen po zhig btang nas bsdad 'dug me rim bzhin chung du song mtshams nyin dmag rnams smyug ma'i khang pa zhig bzos 'dug pa de'i nang kha khu sim por nyal song ba'i dus skabs de dang bstun nas nga tshos smyug ma dang nags gseb khrod nas mi re re byas te bskyod pas thar te de nub klo la la gsham du la dmar brag phug ces pa zhig yod pa der yang sdod ma nus par mi rnams kha grams nas nags gseb tu nyal te bsdad/ de'i sang nyin gnas bar rmo klo zer bar nyin phyed tsam la 'byor yang der khyim dud kha shas las med stabs nyin dmag gis rjes 'ded btang dogs kyis gnas bar rong du phyin nas zhag sdod byas/de'i sang nyin rang khyim mar gong du 'byor/ lam ston du khrid pa'i bde chen thang shar phyogs dbang rgyal tshan 'phel chos dar klo la'i la rtsa nas phyir slog byas shing / kho pas dogs zon med par phyin stabs smyug la rtser nga tsho rjes 'ded gtong bar yong mkhan gyin dmag sum cu skor dang skad sgyur tshe ring bcas thug ste khyed rang mar kong gi dos skyel du phyin pa red ces nyes rdung tshad med btang 5ཿ

nas mi'i sgal par 'khyer dgos pa bzos rkyen zla gcig song mtshams 'das rtse grongs song lugs go thos byung / nga tsho nang du 'byor nas zla ba gsum song rjes nyin rdus bde thang padma chos dar nga'i sar btang ste khyed tsho bros byol song 'dugade min nga tshos(nyin rdu)me mda' phyir sprod bya rtsis yod ces pa'i kha lan dang sbrags me mda' gnyis skur 'dug skabs der pad chos mnyam du chos dar 'das po'i bu shing sdong yang 'byor byung / kho par sgom bu'i phyu pa gsar rkyang zhig dang / sked gri ring po gcig de min nyer mkho gang 'tshams sprad nas phyir kkog btang /de nas gnas tshang las sbyin nged gnyis nying khri dwags kong yan lag las khungs su bskyod de sbas chags sri'i yong rkyen phra zhib snyan seng zhus pas las sbyin la srid gzhung gis dngul sgor lnga bcu tham pa dang / ja 'khor drug gcig gnang ste phran la kho pa 'dir sdod ring 'tsho bar lta skyong yag po byed dgos gsungs byung / las sbyin kho pa phran sar lo gsum bsdad rjes sbas chags shri nas spun rgan pa bde thang byang chub 'byor te nyin rdus las sbyin la bsun rtser spu tsam mi byed pa'i 'phros mol zin pas phyir log byed rogs zer don ltar phyir log song /1953lo'i bod zla brgyad pa'i nang sbas chags shri nal nyin rdus ched mngags bde thang(sgang ma)padma rgyal mtshan bang mir btang mdun sgar chags gzhis 'dzin bar thang bye gzhis(da lta rin spungs rdzong khongs)dpal 'bar dang / rab gsal byang ma/ thob rgyal lha ri drung yig rdo rje rnam rgyal bcas la yi ge btang don/ sbas chags shri'i sa mtshams skor sgar chags gzhis sdod dang / mi ser/ gtso drag bcas 'phros mol byed par bsam dga' zam par yong dgos zhes gsal ba de 'phral gzhis sdod mi gsum gyis mi ser tsho tshan so sor sa gnas rgan po dang 'thus mi re yong dgos pa'i yi ge btang ba ltar rgya 63

'go khrul khungs nas phrin mar kong yi shes dgra 'dul dang / g.yog gnas lung chus tshe 'phar padma rnam rgyal/ 'thus mi chog grub/ sgo zhol nas chu shar rnam grol dang / g.yog po padma bsod nams(da lta nying khri shan spyi bde cus su yod)'thus mi sgar chags o lo/ gnas bar nas rmo lo grong gsar chos bzang dang /'thus mi gcig sbas gzhis sras chung tshe bstan rdo rje ngo g.yog gnyis dang /'thus mi sba ra zla ba rgyal po/ ka dong nas padma rnam rgyal dang / 'thus mi bai shi blo bzang / bam rtsegs nas rta slog dang / 'thus mi dgra 'dul/ ka gsar nas tshe ring dpal ldan ngo g.yog gnyis dang / 'thus mi gcung bu/ gyar gzhis nas a dar rin chen dang g.yog dbang rgyal/ 'thus mi gcig sgar gzhis dpal 'bar dang / rdo rje rnam rgyal/ rab byang / g.yog po gsum bcas mi grangs nyi shu rtsa drug dang / gnas bar nas sbas chags shri'i khongs phar sprod tshur len byed dgos pa'i sba rang padma mchog grub sogs mi bcu gcig bcas rang phyogs nas khyon bsdoms mi grangs sum cu so bdun bskyod cing / brla mdo dang / bha dres/ bam grong / sho kha sogs skabs der dus tshod kyis rkyen pas 'thus mi yong thub ma song / nga tsho bsam dga' zam par 'byor skabs nyin rdu ba slebs zin 'duganyin rdu phyogs nas skad sgyur tshe ring dang / rogs g.yog chabs cig gyin rdus gso skyong byas nas nyin gos gyon pa'i klo yul mthil gyi klo rigs pho gsar mi drug dang / sbas chags shri'i yul mi'i gras/ po ti gi(rgan po las mtho tsam zhig gi go ming)lha lung nag bzang ka klu/ sgang ma(rgan po'i ming)bde chen thang gi nag bzang padma rgyal mtshan/ bde chen thang gi shar phyogs dbang rgyal tshan 'phel/ sangs rgyas las grags/ bde chen thang gi 'phel las tshan 'phel/ sde pa chos bzang / bde chen thang gi nag bzang tshan 'phel padma chos dar/ bde ca4

chen thang gi nag bzang byang chub/ zhing bar gtsug lag tshan 'phel/ sgang ma rta dum phur pa/ bsod nams tshan 'phel lhag pa/ dar rgyas gling tshan 'phel sgang ma rdor bsam rtun bu/ phar bkas rgya nag tshan 'phel sangs rgyas/ dga' lhu tshan 'phel rta bung / sman chu kha rgod po tshan 'phel chos dar/ shar phyogs gcung pad/ lha lung nag bzang tshan 'phel sangs rgyas 'brong / phur pa/dga' gling bun tshogs sangs rgyas rdo rje/ re kong tā bum gyi klo rigs mi bdun brgyad tsam sogs khyon mi grangs sum cu skor 'dug pa rnams dang nga tsho mnyam du bsam dga' zam pa'i gnas bar phyogs kyi bsam dga' spang khar 'tshogs shing /dang thog sgar chags gzhis sdod gnyis kyis sgo nga lnga brgya tsam khyer 'dug pa de dag skad sgyur tshe ring la sprad pa dang / skad sgyur tshe ring gis bshad sgra dang /tsha rong / de min sku drag 'ga' shas kyi 'dra par bstan pa dang sbrags kho pa rang nyid kyi go gnas sa heb ang dang po yin lugs dang / kho pa'i 'dra par gyi gsham du nyin rdu'i yi ge yod pa zhig kyang bstan byung / de rjes 'phros mol 'go tshugs te kho pa tshos brjod don/ nga tsho di li gsar pa nas yin/ sbas chags shri ni nga tsho rgya gar gyi sa khongs yin zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan ni sa 'dir 'bras skye ba dang / bod dang mi 'dra ba'i shing nags yod pa red/ da lam nga tsho 'dir yong dgos don ni sbas chags shri'i yul mi phan tshun 'gro 'ong byed skabs khyod tshos khral bsdu len byas na 'grig gi ma red ces bshad song / skabs der gzhis sdod gnyis pos de lan gang yang bshad ma song yang nga rang(ye shes dgra 'dul)gis nga tsho'i sa dang nga tsho'i mi la khyed tshos jus gtogs byed dgos don med/ snga lo nged spun gnyis sbas chags shrir khrul bsdur yong skabs bla phyag las khungs kyi bka' rgya ngo ma khyed tshor bstan yang rtsis med du btang ste nyin rdu nas tar lan 'khyor ma byung zhes mgo bskor thog don du nga tsho zla ba lnga dang phyed ka tsam dubya

bkag bskyil byas nas sdug mnar tshad med btang khar bsdus zin pa'i nga tsho'i khrul rigs bsdus pa'i dngos po rnams kyang khyod tshos btsan 'phrog byas pa sogs kyi skor da lta mjug tu shod rgyu yin/ sbas chags shri ni lo ngo stong gi sngo na nas bod sde pa gzhung gi sa khongs bston med la brten sde pa gzhung gis khrul bsdu khrims gnod byed mus ma zad/ bar lam gzims lha klur tā la sku phreng bcu gnyis pa'i khyongs sgon kha 'dzin du byung bas sgar gzhis nas khrul bsdu khrims gnon byed mus bcas 'byed khru she bam dang / khyongs thebs su stsal ba'i gtan tshig yig rigs sogs la sde pa gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i tham ga dmar nag gis rgyas chod khungs btsan yod cing / de bzhin mi'i thad la'ang bod mi bston med yin pa ni mi rgyud gang nas byung ba sa gnas 'di rang gi mi la gsal po shod rgyu yod pa bcas la brten rgya gar bas sbas chags shrir ham shed btsan 'dzul byas pa'i gdong ris nga tshos gsal po mthong byung zhes nan tshigs bsgraṭa pas/ skad sgyur tshe ring gis ma red ma red bod kyi sa cha red/ 'on kyang bshad sgras nga tshor sprad pa red ces zer/ ngas bshad sgras sprad yod na yig rigs khyer shog ces bshad par kho pa tshor yig rigs sne gcig ston yas mi 'dug ngas da dung 'di skor sbas chags shri'i sde pa chos bzang la skad cha dris shig ces bshad pas/ chos bzang nga tsho'i sar tshur tsam yong nas/ nga rang de ring rgya gar bas shog zer mkhan mi 'dug kyang / sbas chags shri'i sa mi'i bdag dbang skor 'phros mol byed kyi yod pa go thos byung stabs ched mngags yong ba yin/ rtsa ba'i dpon po sgar chags gzhis bzhugs dbu 'dzin rnam gsum dang / bka' bdag(bka' gtan tshigs kyi bdag po)rgan po spyi pa'i 'thus mi bcas phebs nas de ring mjal thub pa yag po byung / sbas chags shri sa gnas kyi yig rigs nyar mkhan nga rang yin/ sbas chags shri'i sa mi gnyis ka ri bdag thob bod sde pa 56

gzhung oṃn pa'i khungs bskyel ngas byed kyi yin/ sbas chags skre ni bod sa bston med yin pa las rgya gar gyi khongs su gtogs lugs lo rgyus yig rigs gang gi nang du'ang ngas mthong ma myong la rna bas kyang thos ma myong / nga rang gi dran tshod nas bshad na mi thog bzhi phyin song ba nas mi thog gsum gyis sbas chags shri'i sde pa byas pa'i dang po po'o 'phrin las rdo rjes sde pa lo bcu bzhi byas pa dang /gnyis pa nga'i pha padma rdo rjes lo dgu byas pa/ gsum pa nga rang chos bzang gis lo bcu bzhi byas pa de'i ring sbas chags shri rgya gar ba'i sa cha yin lugs rtsa ba nas thos ma myong la/ da phan mi snyan pa sbrang skad tsam yang shod mkhan med pa dang / klo yul gting du'ang rgya gar ba slebs lugs thos myong med/ mi thog bzhi pa da lta nga'i bu bkra shis yin/ gal te khyod kyis bshad pa ltar yin dbang du btang na'ang bod sde pa gzhung la 'phros mol byas te nga tshor sde pa gzhung gi bka' rgya dang 'brel lam ka yod sa lung pa'i stod nas yong dgos kyang / khyod tsho rgya gar ba ni lam med sa lung pa'i rkub nas yong ba'i rkun ma dang jag pa ham shed can bod chos ldan zhing khams la gnod pa skyel mkhan zhig bcas yin pas de ring nas bzung sbas chags sri'i sa mi yongs rdzogs sngar bzhin bod sde pa gzhung nas bdag po rgyag rogs gnang zhes bshad 'phral skad sgyur tshe ring yar langs te chos bzang gi brang khog la 'khar rgyug lan gnyis btsugs nas khyod bshad mi dgos phar rgyugs zer bas chos bzang yar langs nas nga tsho'i gur nang du song / skabs der nga rang yang khong khro langs te yar langs nas skad sgyur tshe ring gi brang mtshams nas bzung bas nga'i 'gram du slebs pa'i mi mang pos kyang bshad don/ rgya gar ba sa mi rku mkhan khyod tsho de ring nying khri krung dbyang dwags 'o/nga yan lag las khungs su khrid kyi yin zhes brjod de nga tshos khu tshur zhu bzhin du zhags rgyang gang tsam khrid skabs kho pas phyin chog 'on kyang 67

nying khri nas thag gcod mi thub pas nga pe cin du skyel gyi red/ spa cin nas rgya gar du phyir log gtong gi red ces zer/ nga tshos skad sgyur tshe ring kho pa khrid nas nying khri las khungs su rtsis sprod bya rgyur thag bcad kyang sgar chags gzhis sdod gsum gyis khrid ma bcug par nga tshor gshe gshe btang thog kho pa glod du bcug pa ma zad/ da dung nga tshor khyod tshos chag sgo slong grabs byed kyi 'dugachag sgo byung na mgo dang / mu ge byung na mtha'i dpe ltar sde pa gzhung gis nged gzhis sdod gsum la bka' ci gnang shes kyi ma red/ des ma tshad khyod rang mi ser tshor yang lus thog la bkod pa shod nges yin/ da lam sbas chags shri'i sa mtshams skor thag chod thabs mi 'dug ces bshad song bas gzhis sdod dang nga tsho mi ser rgan 'thus rnams log yong dgos byung /rgya gar bas 1961lor sbal chags shrir btsan 'dzul byed skabs thog mar klo yul brgyud de yong bas klo yul gyi g.yag steng(klo dmar hreng yang zer)du nyin dmag 40skor dang sa heb dang thung si sogs mi 'ga' shas 'byor te khul de'i klo par khyod tsho nga tsho rgya gar ba'i sa mi red ces bshad 'dug par klo pas lam seng mda' dang mdung sogs la brten nas phar rgol gyis rgya gar ba'i dpon rigs gcig gnyis tsam ma gtogs bsad pa dang / chu 'gor dug btab ste dmag mi mang po shi skad/ de rjes rgya gar bas klo pa'i sa khul der gnam gru btang ste sbam dbyugs nas sa 'bur zhig gi steng sgo dud brgyad cu skor yod pa'i grong tsho de dag tshang ma gtor 'dug skabs der klo pa mang po bsad pa dang / nags gseb tu mi 'ga' shas las ma thar ba/ rgya gar bas bzung thub pa'i klo mi'i bu 'ga' zhig rgya gar du khrid nas btson khang du lo mang bcug pa/ de rjes gong gsal nags gseb tu bros thar ba nyung shas rnams kyang mgo btags dgos byung ba'i gnas tshul de dag klo pas nga rang la zer gyi 'dug58

gong gsal lo rgyus ngon dngos kyi thog nas sbas chags shri ni kong po rtse la rdzong khongs sgar chags gzhis ka zhes ring mo zhig nas lha klu'i 'dzin khongs su gyur pa'i krung go'i bod sa gnas kyi khongs gtogs bston che da yin gshis khul de'i khrul bsdu khrims gnon mtha' dag sgar chags gzhis kyis byed pa'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos sus kyang 'khyog bshad bya thabs bral ba'i gnas lugs nga tsam ma zad sbas chags shri sa khul gyi mi tshang ma'i sems su rdo la ri mo brkos pa ltar gnas yo da cing / 1953lor rgya gar ba dang sgar chags gzhis sdod gsum gyis gtsos nga tsho mi ser rgan 'thus bcas kyis sa mtshams skor gleng mol byed skabs su'ang sbas chags shri ni bod sa bston med la brten sngar nas bod sde pa gzhung gis khrul bsdu khrims gnon byed mus yin lugs ngas kho pa tshor gsal por bshad yod/ lhag par lo rgyus kyi yig rigs dang / de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sgo khru she bam sogs mang po'i nang zhib 'khod yod la/ 1951lor bla phyag las khungs nas btang ba'i bka' rgya zhig kyang skabs der kho pa tsho'i mig lam du bstan yang bden pas dbul te lta ma nus pa sogs mdor na rgya gar ba dang 'brel ba gtan nas med pa'i bod sa bston med cig yin pa las/ rgya gar bas‘‘sa khul 'di bod dang mi 'dra ba'i nags tshal yod pa dang 'bras kyang skyes pa’ zer ba dang / yang‘‘me mda' dbyin ji'i rin 'bab hūṃ sprad pa red’ zer ba/‘‘bshad sgras sprad pa red ’zer ba sogs gang byung khungs med shod pa de dag ni lo rgyus kyi gzhi 'dzin sa til 'bru tsam med nges ngas tshig thag bcad nal bshad chog pa zhig yin/ der brten krung nyin rgyal khab gnyis ni khyim mtshes rgyal khab yin pa dang / krung gyin mi dmangs dbar chos lugs dang / mdza' mthun 'brel lam gyi rgyun srol la b.lam gzhigs kyis gnad don ji yong zhi ba'i gros mol la brten nas thag gcod thub rgyur yid ches dang re 'dun byed bzhin yod/bya

nga dang hin rdu btsan 'dzul dmag dbar byung ba'i rtsod gleng zhigasmin gling zla mchogangs de snga klo pa gzhung rgyugs pa'i khrul bdag byed myong yod pas/ rang rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams klo yul sa mi'i skor la rang nyid kyi myong tshor rags tsam gleng na/ klo pa zhes pa'i thog ma'i mi rgyud byung tshul ni lo rgyus thog gna' rabs su bod la a bo zla nyid dang / zla blo zhes pa bu spun gnyis byung zhing / zla blo bod du bsdad pa dang / zla nyid klo yul du song ste bsdad pa/ zla nyid la bu bzhi byung zhing / bu rgan pa sdong po zer ba des klo yul gyi sbo lo zer ba'i lung tshan bzung nas bsdad pa dang / bu gnyis pa dkar po zhes pa des ma ṇi sgang(klo skad du 'bo dkar)gi lung tshan bzung nas bsdad pa/ bu gsum pa me tog khul shing rmong(mi smyo'am klo skad du spang pho'ang zer) du bsdad pa/ bu bzhi pa gnas shis(da lta lho kha kron chus khongs mtsho sna'i lho rgyud kyi klo pa)khul du bsdad pa(khul der kong po'i kha skad du gcer thang / klo skad du tag kyin)bcas la brten da lta'i skabs su'ang me tog khul dang ma ṇi sgang pa'i khul sogs gong gsal bu bzhi bsdad pa'i lung tshan rnams tshang mas nga tsho tshang ma bu spun yin ces shod kyi yod cing / mdor na klo yul khul gyi mi rnams thog mar bod 60

nas mched pa zhig yin pa ha cang gsal po yod la/ klo pa'i bu dang bu mo rnams mdun gyi skra rtse 'breg srol yod pas/ kha rgyun du gdong skra rtse bregs tshad bod kyi mi yin ces pa'i zer srol yang yod/ de bzhin sngar lam khrul rigs sgrub phyogs kyi thad nas kyang / dper na/ dom la phar rgyab tu klo pa rgan khag lnga yod pa ste/ (1)ma ṇi sgang gi sa khongs bde chen steng pa(klo skad du mdung nyog)gzhung rgyugs pa yin pa de'i khrul bdag nga rang yin/ (2)zhwa byi'i(klo skad du 'jem san)sger bshad sgra ba'i khongs gtogs khrul bdag dung tsho gnas khag (3)g.yu rung(klo skad du he'i tha'o)rtse yig tshang las khungs kyi khongs gtogs khrul bdag gnas yi'i/ (4)ram btso(klo skad du rda mang)sger bshad sgra'i khongs gtogs khrul bdag gdung tsho/ (6)'ba' rong / rtse yig tshang las khungs kyi khongs gtogs khral bdag gnas yi'i bcas yin pa gong gsal rgan khag lnga so so nas lo ltar sde pa gzhung la khrul 'bab si paṇa khal 6re dang /dmar btsod 'degs khal 12('degs khal 12la mon rdo 1)re/ sbrang rtsi shu gu(smyug mdong zhig)gang re bcas 'bul dgos pa dang / rgan khag lnga'i khongs min pa'i klo pa yo dkar sha ram khongs nas lo rer rgyal ba rin po che'i nam rgyu 'pher nges zhes pa'i sram gyi pags pa mtho 9lon pa re 'bul dgos pa bcas gong gsal khrul 'bab rnams rgan po so so nas bsdus te lo ltar bod zla 10tshes 25nyin khrul bdag so so'i sar skyel bar yong dgos dang / de dag khrul bdag so so nas rtse la rdzong lo re'i khrul bzhes bsdu bar yong skabs 'bul dgos pa bcas klo pa'i khrul 'bab rnams 1965bar bsdu mus yin kyang / de rjes 1956 lor rtse la rdzong bla ma rgya bo dang shod drung sa lung ba mchin pa mdor khral bsdur slebs skabs klo pa rkang zhabs kyis gtsos mi 'ga' zhig yong ste klo pa'i khrul rnams ma basbru rogs gnang zhes zhus song bas skabs der rdzong 61

dpon gnyis nas de skor bka' shag la snyan seng zhu rgyu yin lugs dang / gal te bka' shag nas bsdu len byed dgos gsungs tshe bsdu rgyu yin lugs bshad nas gang ltar lo der klo khrul ma bsdus pa dang / de rjes bka' shag nas 'di byed gsal med pas de nas bzung klo khral bsdu rgyu ma byung ba las/ de phan gang ltar khul der sde pa gzhung gis khral bsdu khrims gnon byed kyi yod pa bcas lo rgyus dang dngos don gang gi thad nas kyang klo yul ni bod sa bston med yin pa ha cang gsal po yod/spyi lo 1956lor gus pa'i g.yog zla yor dang khong gi bza' zla mkha' 'gro gnyis glo yul du yul byol song stabs/ 1957lo kho pa gnyis bskong bar ma ṇi sgang du nga rang ngo bskyod byas shing / skabs de'i klo yul 'go dpon rgya gar ba tā dmang sde pa dang / las byed shang ma bha bu/ skad sgyur/ mon pa spo ti gi(chus krang dang mtshungs)'dug pa kho tsho'i las khungs der yang bka' shag ces zer gyi 'dug nga rang klo yul du slebs 'phral kho pa tsho'i sar yong dgos pa'i 'bod mi btang 'dug pa der skyod skabs yong don dris byung bas/ ngas g.yog gnyis bskong bar yong lugs bshad pa yin/ tā dmang sde pas g.yog gnyis bya rigs la dpe blangs te nyin mo thag ring du bskyod kyang dgong mo tshang du log pa ltar khong gnyis klo pa klo yul du log yong ba yin pas/ phyir sprod bya thabs med ces zer byung / ngas kho pa gnyis khrul mi yin pas/ rtse la rdzong gi sgo khru ming gzhung nang tshud yod ces bshad par tā dmang sde pas khyod rang la sde pa gzhung gi go gaspre/sa gang yod dam zer bar/ ngas 'phags yul grong tsho bcu gnyis kyi gnas khag cig yin la glo pa'i khrul bdag kyang yin zhes bshad/ yang kho pa tshos gung khrun gyi go gnas gang yod dam zer/ ngas rtse la rdzong rim pa'i don gcod khang gi rdzong dpon gzhon pa yin zhes bshad/ yang kho pa tshos khyed 62 lke

rang nyin shas skugs dgos/ gang ltar mi ni sprod thabs med pas gnad don 'di skor di lir tar thog nas snyan seng zhu gi yin zer/ de nas nyin bcu gsum song rjes kho tsho'i las khungs su rkog zer ba ltar skyod skabs tā dmang sde pa dang / shang ma bha bu/ skad sgyur nor bzang / kho pa tshos bskos pa'i klo pa'i 'go dpon spo ti gi byams pa dang / da lung zla ba/ 'gang ma mi bcu bzhi bcas mnyam du bsdad 'dug cing / tā dmang sde pas di li nas tar 'byor byung /khyod kyi mi gnyis la mi rin sgor chig stong re sgod zer gyi 'dug ces bshad byung bar/ ngas mi ni khrul mi red/ nga ni mi bskong bar yong ba las mi rin len par yong ba min zhes bshad par/ tā dmang sde pas mi rin ma blangs na'ang gang ltar mi ni sprod kyi min zhes zer gyi 'dug de lan ngas mi gnyis kyis ma tshad klo yul gyi sa mi yongs rdzogs nga tsho bod kyi yin/ khyod tshor gang 'dra byas nas bdag gam zhes bshad pas/ tā dmang sde pas de sngon rgya gar dbyin ji'i khongs tshud pa rang btsan byung rjes sa bkra zhib bsher skabs klo yul sa mi rnams dbyin ji'i sa bkra'i khongs su bcug 'dug pas de don ltar bdag po sprad pa yin ces zer/de lan ngas de ltar yin na rgya gar hril po nga tsho'i sa bkra'i nang bkod de bdag bzung byas na 'grig gam bshad pa yin/ tā dmang sde pas spo ti gi dang 'gang ma rnams la skad cha de rang red ces bshad song / skabs der spo ti gi dang 'gang ma rnams 'jam thing nger sdod skabs klo pa'i 'gang ma sing long yor bus zla mchog gi mi gnyis phyir sprod byed dgos nges red/ zla mchog gis bshad pa ltar klo yul gyi sa mi rnamal zla mchog gi red ces bshad song / skabs der tā dmang sde pas klo yul gyi sa mi'i skor sde pa gzhung gis jus gtogs byed kyi red/ zla mchog gi mi gnyis phyir sprod byed kyi min zhes bshad rjes/ yang kho pus sing long yor bur khyod rang gang byung bshad na srog gi nyes chad phog gi 6 3

red ces bshad song / sing long yor bus ngas skad cha drang po bshad pa de la srog gi nyes pa yod na bsang na'i gsod/ mi ni gang ltar sa rdo chags rgyu rang red ces bshad song / gang ltar skabs der nyin rdus ka kor sna tshogs kyi sgo nas g.yog zla yor dang khong gi bza' zla mkha' 'gro gnyis phyir sprod ma byas pa red/19pya8lo'i bod zla brgyad pa'i nang nor bzang dang klo pa khur 'khyer mi gnyis nga'i sar yong ste yi ge zhig sprad byung ba de ni bod yig red/ yi ge sbyar byed la cha'i steng gi the'ur nyin rdu'i las rtags seng ge mgo gsum yod pa zhig brgyab 'dug yi ge'i nang khyod kyi mi gnyis phyir sprod byas chog sa mtshams skor la thag gcod bya rgyur khyod rang ma ṇi sgang du yong na 'grig la/ nga tsho dom la tshur rgyab kho mo 'ba' khog tu yong na'ang 'grig ces 'khod 'dug pa ma zad/kha lan yang de ltar bskur 'dug ngas nga la g.yog tshod ma gtogs dpon tshod med gshis/ de'i skor rtse la rdzong dang krung gung nying khri yan lag las don u yon lhan khang la snyan zhu phul dgos zhes bshad pa yin/ de rjes rang re'i yang hphu'u si ling yon nga'i nang la phebs byung bas gong gsal gnas tshul rnams zhus pa dang sbrags kho tshos(hin rdu)btang ba'i yi ge de'ang 'bul lam zhus pa yin/yang hphu'u si ling yon gyis sa mtshams thag gcod bya rgyu'i thad rtse la rdzong dang /krung gung nying khri yan lag las don u yon lhan khang nas thag gcod bya thabs med/ de ni lha sar phyi don gyi las khungs yod pa de nas thag gcod byed kyi red ces gsungs byung / de don kha la'i 'gang ma gling chen la lan bskur ba yin/des na ngas de snga klo pa gzhung rgyugs pa'i khrul bdag byed ring me khe ma hung gi sa thig zer ba dang dbyin ji'i sa bkra zer ba de dag gang yin shes kyi med la mthong yang ma myong / rang gis cha rgyus yod pa ni klo pa'i sa mi'i bdag po bod yin pa ni don dngos kyi rgyu mtshan ra 'phrod ha cang gsal po yod/64

sbas chags shri ni rang rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med yin/shang sdong gis/deng skabs rgya gar bas btsan bzung byas pa'i sbas chags shri ni gna' rabs nas bod sa gnas kyi cha shas kong po rtse lha rdzong khongs sgar chags gzhis ga'i khongs su gtogs pa zhig yin cing / de'i sa mi'i khrul rigs dang khrims gnon sogs tshang ma sgar chags gzhis kyis byed kyi yod pas rnga ma nag po'i mdog ltar sus kyang bsgyur mi thub pa'i bod kyi sa khongs bston med cig yin/nga'i mes po rnams sa gnas der skyes nal 'tsho ba ma zad/ rang nyid kyang sbas chags shri khul yol go grong tshor skyes nas 'tshar longs byung ba zhig yin stabs sbas chags shri khul gyi mi dmangs spyi dang 'dra bar sbas chags shri'i lo rgyus ngas kyang cung zhib phra shes kyi yod/zas chags zi'i sa gnas kyi lo rgyus/ dus rabs bcu bzhi pa dang / bco lnga'i nang grub thob thang stong rgyal po sbas chags shri khul du phebs nas 1 padma shugs yub dang / 2 padma dkyil gling / 3 yug pa mkhar nag 4 shel dkar bum chung dang zhing bar g.yang 65

tshab bum pa/ 5 bka' gter phug pa'i bum chung bcas gnas sgo khag lnga gye ba ma zad/ bum rten yang gsar bzhengs mdzad pa de nas bzung sbas chags shri zhes pa'i yul grong chags shing / de ga'i dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyun du bum rten gsar bzhengs mdzad rjes thang stong rgyal po zhabs thang mar shi la bar byon skabs lam bar nags gseb nas rta zhig thon pa de 'drogs nas chu la mchongs shing / rdo la rta dang khong gi zhabs rjes bzhag yod pa de dag da lta yang mjal rgyu yod pa red ces bshad srol 'dug de bzhin klo yul yang sbas shri'i khongs gtogs yin stabs grub thob thang stong rgyal pos sbas shri'i gnas sgo phye ste yul grong chags rjes mi rabs gsum song mtshams su shor kha stobs ldan gyis shel khang nor 'phel dang / sde pa bkra shis dbang phyug gtsug lag nor bu dbang phyug nag bzang mgon po/ khe le dbang ldan/ khe le pad rdor bcas g.yog tu khrid nas klo yul khul khrul bsdur bskyod pa dang / khrul bsdur bskyod skabs dga' po yeng gong thang du bdo mda'i tsha kha rgyag 'phen byed pa'i lo rgyus yod cing / 'been 'phen shing sdong da lta yang dga' po ye gong thang du mthong rgyu yod pa dang / de nas rta gdong du 'byor pa'i lo rgyus 'di dag sbas chags shri khul pha gtam bu 'jags su gnas pa'i don dngos kyi lo rgyus shig red/chos lugs dang / yul goms gshis lugs/sbas chags shri khul gyi mi dmangs kyis rnying ma'i chos lugs la dad pa byed cing / lo ltar lo gsar dang / drug pa tshes bzhi/ tshes bcu/ nyer lnga sogs gtong srol dang / glu gzhas/ rnam thar/ gar 'cham/ dbyangs rol/ 'bud bkrol/ mo rtsis/ lha phab/ dgon pa'i dge bskos dang / dbu mdzad/ mchod 66

dpon sogs kyi sgrigal gzhi/ rdo lha/ man thang / mtshod rten bcas ni yal lang ༄ ༄gang du ji snyed yod pa sogs chos dad dang / skad yig bcas ni bod yongs dang gcig gyur yin pa dang / 'tsho ba spyod stangs thad bza' btung / gyon chas/ 'tsho ba'i yo chas/ rgyan cha lugs sogs ni bod kyi kong po khul dang dbyer med yin/ khral rigs skub 'angal byed sgo'i skor/sbas chags shri ni lo rgyus thog bod sa gnas kyis gzhung 'dzin byed pa'i sgar chags gzhis ka'i khongs gtogs yin cing / de rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa'i yab gzhis slar yang lha klur gtan 'khel gnang rjes tā la bcu gnyis pa'i yab gzhis 'khyongs sgon du lha klur kha 'dzin gtan 'jags su gnang 'dug pa ltar nga rang gi dran thog tu sgar chags gzhis ka ni bod gzhung gi sku drag lha klu ba'i 'dzin khodzos su gtogs pas sbas chags shri'i mi ser rnams la khrul bsdu khrims gnon sogs tshang ma sgar chags gzhis kas byed kyi yod pas sgar chags gzhis sdod kyis sbas chags shri'i sde pa zhes lo gsum re mtshams gsar pa re bsko bzhag byed kyi 'dug rang nyid kyi dran thog tu pad rdor dang /rta rkyang dbang ldan/ nor bu dbang phyug gtsug lag bla ma/ shar lcog rdo rje phun tshogs/ 'go pa a dar/ nor dpal/ bso na bkra shis dbang phyug bso na rdo rje phun tshogs/ nag bzang bkra shis phun tshogs/ nag bzang lha dbang /nag bzang mgon po/ khe le chos bzang / nag bzang spen pa(da lta 'tsho bzhugs)bcas kyis sbas chags sri'i sde pa byas po dang / sde pa'i 'og tu drung yig gcig yod pa rta rgyas zer bas sde pa las thog mang po'i drung yig byas so/chi 67

di dung lung tshan so sor spyi mi zhis pa re yang bsko bzhag byed kyi yod pa nga'i dran thog tu lha lung spyi mi rta shog dang / nang so spyi mi mgon po/ ma ṇi sgang spyi mi a dar/ khang gsar spyi mi rta shog sman chu kha spyi mi shar ltog dpal skyed/lcags ri nang spyi mi zla bo/ zhing bar spyi mi rdo rje tshe ring(da lta zhing bar rang la bsdad yod)bcas kyis byas song zhing / sbas chags shri'i mi ser nas sgar chags gzhis kar 'bul dgos pa'i khrul rigs rnams gong gsal sde pa dang / spyi mi zhes pas 'gan 'khur te sbas chags shri'i mi ser che 'bring chung gsum la cha gses bsdu len gyis sgar chags gzhis su sgrub 'jal zhu dgos kyi yod pa zhib phra'i bsdu stangs thad lo bco lnga yan dang drug bcu man gyi mi re nas lo ltar mi bogs ṭam bcu re dang / khrul dud che ba re nas dmar btsod 'degs khal nyi brgya tham pa re dang dom lngags gcig kha sha'i pags pa gcig rgya ra'i pags pa gcig sbrang rtsi sbrang mdong gsum/ 'bras khal gnyis/ si pan khal gnyis re dang / khrul pa 'bring gras them dud re nas dmar btsod 'degs khal brgya tham pa dang / kha sha'i pags pa gnyis/ rgya ra'i pags pa gcig dom lngags gcig si pan khal gnyis/ 'bras khal gcig bre bcu/ sbrang rtsi sbrang mdong gnyis re/ khrul pa chung gras them dud re nas/ dmar btsod 'degs khal sum cu tham pa dang / kha sha'i pags pa gcig 'bras bre bcu/ si pan khal gnyis/sbrang rtsi sbrang mdong gcig bcas lo ltar 'go pa so so brgyud grangs tshad sprad de byung 'dzin len dgos pa dang / sgar chags gzhis sdod nas sngar srol ltar dmar btsod 'degs khal nyis brgya tham pa rer tshwa khal gnyis dang rtsam khal gcig dang / yang dmar btsod khal brgya tham par tshwa khal gcig dang rtsam khal gcig dmar btsod khal sum cu tham par tshwa bre bcu dang rtsam bre bcu bcas so sor sprod srol 'dra min ltar sprod kyi yod pa dang / de bzhin sgar chags gzhis 68

sdod kyi ngo tshab yong skabs skul dam sngon btang ltar sdod sgrig 'thus tshang byed dgos/ sgar chags gzhis sdod kyi ngo tshab g.yog rigs dang sbas shri'i sde pa sogs phyogs thon skabs sbas shri'i mi ser nas khur skyel 'ul mi gtong dgos pa dang / sprel lo nam shar gyi rtsa ri rong skor skabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' lam ltar lam rgyus pa sbas sri'i mi ser nas 'gro dgos pa/ sgar chags gzhis ka'i thab shing gcod 'dren la kong po rla mdo dang / sba kha yan dang /nal pa phul mdo/ sbas chags shri bcas nas lo res 'khor gyis lo ltar mi lnga bcu skor rigro dgos pa/ sbas chags sri khul si pan sos pa thon skabs sbas shri'i mi spyi nas sgar chags gzhis sdod su si pan sngon po mi khur gcig dang /sgar chags zhol pa khrul dud rnams la si pan bre bcu/ shar spyog gzhis sdod la si pan khal gcig 'ba' rang gzhis sdod la si pan khal gcig skad gdong gzhis sdod la si pan khal gcig mo khong gzhis sdod la si pan khal gcig rmo lo 'brong gsar rgan po chos bzang la si pan khal gcig ka gsar gzhis sdod la si pan khal gcig skyar gzhis sdod la si pan khal gcig bcas lo ltar sprod dgos pa de dag dang thog sbas shri'i mi spyi nas lag rtags su sprad pa rjes su khrul du bsgyur ba red/sbas chags shri'i mi ser rnams dbus gtsang dang / kong po khul sogs la tshong du bskyod skabs sgar chags gzhis sdod la mi re nas zhu rten snyug slo gru bzhi gsum re dang / kha sha'i pags pa re sprad de lam yig zhus nas 'gro dgos pa las lam yig med par gang byung 'gro bskyod mi chog cing / de bzhin mi ser phan tshun gyod gzhi byung skabs thog mar sbas shri'i 'go par zhu gtugs byed dgos pa des 'khrun gcod ma thub tshe sgar chags gzhis sdod la zhu gtugs kyis 'khyun gcod byed kyi yod pa/ dper na/ phran rang lo bcu drug tsam skabs shel 69

khang spen pa'i dmedzo mo zhig brlags pa tshas nang ku lung la rkun btsugs byas pa dang / nag bzang gcung pa'i glang zhig brlags pa khum dong da yor la rkun btsugs byas pa'i gyod zhib sbas shri'i sde pa chos bzang gis byas song ba de dus nga rang yang chu len dang khur skyel du 'gro myong zhing / gal te sbas shri'i sde pas gyod 'khrun ma chod tshe sgar chags gzhis sdod la snyan seng zhu dgos pa/ dper na/ sman chu dkyil sgar rdo rje tshe ring gis bde chen thang pa bzang tshe ring gi bza' zla bsam 'phel 'phrog skabs sbas shri'i sde pa chos bzang gis 'khrun chod ma thub par sgar chags gzhis sdod la snyan zhus ltar kho pa'i bza' zla bsam 'phel rdo rje tshe ring la bdag pa'i thag gcod byas song / sbas shri'i sde par gyod gtugs skabs gyod 'khrun ma chod bar sde pa'i nang mi ji yod dang / spyi mi/ drung yig bcas kyi sto chang gyod ya phan tshun res 'khor gyis gtong dgos kyi 'dug klo yul yang bod khongs bston med yin pa kho tsho'i nang du rigs rgyud gsum yod pa ste/ rtsa ri mthil bkra bar dang gcig ram sog 'bo la bar dang gnyis/ padma bkod mthil gding klo dang gsum bcas yin cing / de dag so sor thog ma'i 'byung khungs re yod pa/ dper na/ yol gor dang rdor gling gnyis kyi klo rigs ni bod khongs bsam yas klo nas byung bas klo rdo phu pad dkar zer ba ltar red/ khong tshos bod la khrul 'jal khrims 'khur byed dgos kyi yod pa/ ram nag klo pas 'ba' rang gzhis dang / gdung rnyog klo pas smin gling zla mchog yul rong klo pas gdung mdo gong / dpung dbyings klo pas sbang 'jag par skyes/ rta mang klo pas nag yul bcas dpon khongs so sor lo ltar dmar btsod 'degs khal gsum re dang / si pan khal gnyis re/ khyo re nas mi bogs dngul srang bcu re dang mo re nas srang lnga re bcas sgrub 'jal dgos pa ma zad/ smin gling zla mchog gis 1956bod me sge lo bar gdung rtog 70

klo pa nas khrul 'bab sngar bzhin bsdu mus yin pa bcas rgya gar bas btsan 'dzul byas pa'i gnas tshul/spyi lo1951bod lcags yos lor sbas chags shri khul rgya gar ba'i gnam gru gcig yong ste mkha' thog lding skor kha shas brgyab ste phyir log byas pa dang /slar yang spyi lo 1962bod chu 'brug lor rgya gar ba'i dpon dmag kha shas dang dod skyel 'ul mi bcas khyon bsdoms mi grangs 100yas mas dngos su sbas chags shri khul du yong ba ma zad/ de 'phral mi ser nas bya de dang / sgong nga /shas rgyu'i glang / chang sogs sbas shri'i sde pa las thog spen pa brgyud bsdu len yang byas te lha lung 'dre lag dngos su brkyangs nas krung go'i bod kyi cha shas bston med sbas chags shrir btsan 'dzul byas thog rta bcings spangs khar zhes par gnam gru bab thang bzos pa dang / bha rang sgang sa gnas su dmag sgar gsar rgyag gis dmag dpung gtan sdod kyis rgya gar bas bdag gir bzung rkyang byas te sgar chags gzhis sdod dang sbas shri'i sde par sngar srol khrul rigs mi ser la 'jal 'dod yod kyang 'jal du mi 'jug pa dang / rgyun srol thon skyed dang tshong 'khos thabs len byed du mi 'jug par bkag 'gog byas te kho pa tsho'i lam bzo'i 'ol mi dang / dpon dmag phar tshur 'gro skabs dod skyel 'ol mi sogs mi la dud 'gro bzhin btsan pos skul 'ded byed pa ma zad/ gla 'bab kyang drang 'brel mi sprod cing / lhag par bdag tu bzung ba'i bud med la btsan shed log g.yem byed pa sogs sbas shri khul gyi mi ser la hin rdu bas sngar lo rgyus thog mi grags pa'i mnar gcod brdab gsig tshad med gtong gi yod pa nga rang gi spun nye stos bcas kyis sbas chags shri khul myong mus yin pa'i don dngos rgyu 7zhi

mtshan khungs ldan sha stag yin cing / da dung sbas sri'i mi ser rnams kyis nyin rdu ba'i btsan bshed mnar gcod 'di lta bu'i 'og mi mthun rta g.yag mgo 'brel gnas thabs ye nas med lugs dang / sbas chags dang klo yul mi dmangs rnams sngar lo rgyus grags pa nas bzungs krung go'i bod sa bston med yin pas bod rigs spun zla spyi dang 'dra ba'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang dro skyid kyi 'tsho ba skyel rgyur gcig gyur gyis re 'bod mtha' gcig tu zhu gi 'dug go /

nga sgar chags gzhis sdod las khrog skabs hin rdu'i batren 'dzul dmag gis sbas chags shribatsan bzung byas pa'i gnas tshul dngos/bde rab tshe rjor/ kong po rtse lha rdzong khongs sgar chags gzhirnga ka ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa'i yab gzhis 'khyongs sgon la lha klur kha 'dzin gtan sejags bstsal ba zhig red/ nga tsho ni lha klu'i mi khongs yin stabs/ 944lor lha klus nga'i pha tshe ring lha dbang la sgar chags gzhis sdod bskos shing / de skabs rang nyid kyang mnyam du yod/ de rjes pha'i gzhis sdod kyi lo dus rdzogs mtshamaso nga rang gi ming thog la bskos byung ba nas 1952lo bar pha bu gnyis kyis sgar chags gzhis sdod lo dgu byas pa yin/sgar chags gzhis khongs mi ser la phyi 'don 90la nang 'don 995yod cing / de dag gnas bar dang gnas phyi gnyis la cha gses bgyis pa'i lo re'i khrul 'bab dang / gnas nang zhes pa sbas chags shri'i lung tshan che ba bzhi 'o/da pa ste/ lha lung dang / dga' ba gling / bde chen thang / sman chu kha bcas kyi mi ser nas lo re'i khrul 'bab dam ra btsod dang / 'bras/ si pan/ ṭwāṃg

bu/ rgya ra dang / dom sogs kyi pags pa/ sbrang rtsi bcas them dud so sor cha gses bgyis pa'i thob 'bab dpya khrul re'u mig deb gsal bzhin lo ltar sgar gzhis su 'bul bar yong dgos shing / de dag la sngar lam spus rin zhes mi ser la tshwa rtsam dngul bcas sne sel re sprod srol 'dugadaga' gling khongs dar rgyas gling du gter ston chos rje gling pa'i dgon lag lha rtse dgon zhes pa der grwa grangs 25yod cing / de ni gtso bo tā la'i bla ma mchog gi sku tshe tshe sgrub sgrub mkhan yin pas lo ltar bod zla dang po'i tshes shar la lha klu'i phyag mdzod khang nas lha rtse dgon du dar chen gyi na bza' cha tshang gcig dang / dar lcog lnga tshan tha sna re/ dngul dang / kha btags bcas dam sbyar sgar gzhis brgyud sprod srol de dag lo ltar zla 12pa'i nang sbas chags shri'i 'go pa yong skabs sgar gzhis nas rtsis sprod thog sgar gzhis nas kyang gong mtshungs sprod lam ltar sprod kyi yod/sbas chags shri'i lung tshan bzhi nas lo gsum re'i thog sgar gzhis kyi thab shing gcod mkhan mi grangs nges can re yong ste lo gcig gi thab shing ldeng nges skyel dgos(lo gnyis kyi thab shing gnas bar dang / dga' zhol nas gcod 'bul zhu ba)pa dang / lung tshan so so'i phru gu lo na 8son pa nas bzung sgar gzhis su lo re mi bogs dngul srang 3re 'bul dgos pa de dag khungs so so nas sbas shri'i 'go pas bsdus te sgar gzhis su 'bul bar yong skabs sgar gzhis nas skyes 'chi bsnan bcag dang 'brel sgo khru ming gzhung la mchan bkod byed kyi yod stabs lung tshan phan tshun gnyen sgrig rang mos chog kyang / ming gzhung phar tshur spi rgyu'i thad lo gsum re'i thog sgo khru ming gzhung gsar bkod byed skabs sbas shri'i 'go pas sgar gzhis la snyan seng kha gsal dang 'brel ming gzhung la bsgyur mchan zhu dgos/7

sbas chags sri ba dwags po dang / 'bri gung / 'phan po/ lho kha sogs la tshong du bskyod tshe sgar gzhis nas lam 'dzin zhu dgos pa dang / lam 'dzin zhu bya'i snag shog gi dod smyu gu chu rin zhes mi re nas shog bu bcu lteb 3re sgar gzhis su sprod srol dang / lam 'dzin gyi brjod byar‘‘'di ga'i khongs gtogs sbas chags shri'i mi grangs snusnutshong ba/skyod song ba gtan tshigs she bam rin po che'i dgongs don bzhin da lam thengs gcig ring bkag med shad gtong dgos rgyu'i lam 'dzin du sgar gzhis nas snusnulo'i zla tshes la’ zhes 'bri dgos/lam 'dzin zhu dgos don ni lo re'i khrul 'bab ma gtsang bar tshong bskyod mi chog pa dang / gal te lam 'dzin med par phyin na rdzong gzhis khag nas bkag ste dngos po rnams 'phrog gi yod pa red/sgar gzhis kyis gong gsal mi ser nas khrul 'bab bsdu len gyis lo ltar bla phyag las khungs su mar khal1000tham pa dang / lha klur mar khal 1000dang dre'u 2gur thag star kha/ kham bu/ phag sha dmar btsod/ rgya lngags sogs kyi pags rigs/ shog bu/ sbrang rtsi/ 'bras bcas 'bul dgos kyi yod/sbas chags shri ni thog mar mi med lung stong yin cing / dus rabs bcu bzhi pa tsam nas bzung rim gyis kong po dung tsho dang / dwags po rdza ma/ kong po stod smad/ e/ 'phan po sogs kyi khul nas mi yong ste lung tsho chags pa zhig yin 'dug lung tsho so so'i rgan po dang spyi mi sogs lung tshan so so nas bskos chog kyang / lung tshan bzhi'i 'go dpon ni yul de ga'i mi zhig sgar chags gzhis nas bsko srol yod pas/ nga rang gi phas sgar gzhis 'dzin skabs 'go dpon chos bzang zer ba zhig 'dug de rjes nga rang gis sgar gzhis 'dzin skabs 'go pa gsar pa spen pa zer ba zhig bskos pa yin/ lung tshan bzhi'i gnad don 75

sbas shri'i 'go pas thag gcod mi chog pa rnams sgar gzhis su snyan seng zhu dgos/1951lo sbas chags shri'i 'go dpon spen pa nas sgar gzhis su yi ge btang 'byor byung don / rgya gar pa'i gnam gru 1dang / 'go dpon mi 2/dmag mi dang / dos skyel bsdoms mi grangs brgya skor bcas slebs song zhi nga /skad sgyur rgyal rtse ba tshe ring zer ba zhig 'dug pa kho pas brjod gsal/ sa cha 'di de snga bshad sgra blon chen gyis nga tshor sprad pa red/ da bar brtsad ma chod par lus song zer ba ma zad/ kho pa tshos yul mi rgan gzhon byis pa bcas tshang ma'i ming tho bkod nas mi rer ras kyi stod thung gu thung re sprad thog da nas bzung khrul 'bab nga tshos(rgya gar bas)bsdu gi red/ sgar gzhis su sprad mi chog ces zer lugs 'khod 'dug ngas yig lan du/ las khungs phyi nang gi 'bul 'bab mchod rgyun 'gro yul gal che yin pa khrul deb 'go brjod du gsal 'khod ltar khrul 'bab rnams khyod rang nas bsdu rdzong dgos rgyu zhes btang ba dang 'brel sbas sri'i 'go pa'i yig don lha klur snyan 'bul zhus pa yin/ lha klus bka' shag la'ang snyan seng zhus 'dug kyang thag gcod bka' gsal ma byung ba'i mur 1952lo nas bzung sbas shri'i lung tshan bzhi nas sgar gzhis su khrul 'bab skyel 'bul gyi mtshams chad pa red/des na sbas chags shri ni gna' rabs nas bod sa bston med la brten 1952phan sgar chags gzhis kyis khrul bsdu khrims gnon gyi 'gan dbang spyod mus ma zad/ lhag par du nga'i pha dang nga rang nas khyon sgar gzhis lo dgu tsam bzung ring rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khrul rigs bsdu bskul byas pa'i myong tshor dngos kyi thog dang / de bzhin lo rgyurnga kyi yig rigs dang / bod sa gnas srid 76

gzhung gis yab gzhis 'khyongs sdon du bstsal ba'i skor gyi yig deb/ she bam sogs kyi nang du'ang gsal bar 'khod 'dug pa bcas kyi thog nas sbas shri ni bod sa bston med yin pa'i dngos ra gsal sprod thub nges las rgya gar bas rang bzhin ham bzung byed pa ni don dngos kyi gzhi 'dzin sa gang yang med pa'i khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod rang red/

nga smag sgor khral basbyar bskyod skabs 'gog rkyen 'phrad pa'i gnas tshul dngos/dpal 'byor/nga ni de snga yab gzhis bsam grub pho brang pa'i zhabs khongs zangs ri dkyil khang gi g.yog yin pa dang / mon smag sgo gzhis ka ni de snga yab gzhis bsam pho'i 'dzin khongs yin pas ngas sbyin bdag gi ngo tshab dang mnyam du smag sgo khul khrul bsdur bskyod myong /mon smag sgo zhes pa ni deng sang lho kha kron chus mtsho sna rdzong khongs sbyor ra chus mkhar ltag shang nas rta pa'i nyin lam phyed gnyis kyi mtshams na yod/smag sgor nang gses lung tshan gsum yod pa ste/ smag sgo dang / mthin bu/ lu gu thang bcas yin pa de dag gi bsdus ming la smag mthin lu gsum zer zhing /skabs der mi 'bor chig stong lhag tsam yod/ khong tsho'i rtsa ba'i skad yig bod yongs dang gcig gyur yin rung / rnam kun mon dang smag sgo'i yul skad bed spyod byed kyi yod/ de snga bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bsam grub pho brang par tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa'i yab gzhis kyi 'khyongs thebs su bstsal ba nas bzung sbug dam sbyar ma'i bka' gtan dang 'brel khul de'i 'dzin dbang bdag thob dang khrul bsdu khrims gnon byed po yab gzhis bsam grub pho brang pa yin 78

stobs bsam pho'i zhabs gras khongs nas sbyor ra skyid gshongs gzhis dang /de'i zhor skyong smag sgo bsam grub gzhis gnyis kyi gzhis 'dzin gcig lcogs su gtong srol yod/1934lo bsam pho'i zhabs gras zangs ri dkyil khang nub dpal 'byor zer bar bsam phos tsho dpon du bsko bzhag byas shing / tsho dpon gyis lha sa smon lam sogs la bsam pho'i tshab byas te las ka byed dgos pas gyong gun yod stabs de'i gun gsab tu sbyor ra skyid gshongs gzhis sdod bsko bzhag byas don/ 1959bar gzhis 'dzin lo 25byas 'dug tsho dpon dpal 'byor tshe las 'das tshab de'i bu ye shes bstan 'dzin(deng sto kha sa gnas chab gros rgyun u)gzhis 'dzin gyi ming 'khur yin kyang bu ye shes bstan 'dzin lo na phra bas las go 'pher min la brten gzhis tshab tu ye shes bstan 'dzin gyi a ma'i bza' zla rjes ma byams pa ngag dbang gis skyid gshongs gzhis 'dzin byas pa dang /skyid gshongs gzhis 'dzin gyis smag sgo bsam grub gzhis su khrul 'bab bsdu bar lo re dgun dpyid so sor thengs re bskyod lam ltar 1950lor sngar srol khral bsdu'i brda yig sngon btang gis skyid gshongs gzhis sdod byams pa ngag dbang dang / khong gi g.yog por nga rang(dpal 'byor)smag sgo bsam grub gzhis su khrul bsdur bskyod skabs smag sgo'i nye 'gram du nyin rdu'i sa srung dmag mi bcu shog gcig 'byor ba de dag nyin shas bsdad nas phyir log mtshams slar yang tsa nyi na dmag sum cu tsam spebs bsdad kyis byams pa ngag dbang dang 'brel gtuṭa byas nas thugs spro yang btang song / skabs der nyin dmag gi skad bsgyur skal bzang zhes pa zhig 'dug pa kho par byams pa ngag dbang gis lag rtags nyal zan zhig kyang sprad song / nyin dmag la byams pa ngag dbang gis smag sgo ni nga tsho bod sde pa gzhung gi sa cha bston med la brten mnga' dwags rgyal gsum('on glu

mnga' ris grwa tshang dang / dwags po bshad sgrub gling / chos 'khor rgyal)gyi mchod rgyun gtong dmigs su bsam grub pho brang la kha 'dzin gtan 'jags bstsal ba zhig yin pas nga tsho 'dir sngar lam khrul bsdur yong ba yin zhes bshad song bar/ nyin dmag gis nga tsho ni sa spung pa yin/ sa cha dang khrul bsdu'i skor sa dkar gzhung la skad cha byed par 'gro dgos zhes zer zhing / 'on kyang lo der khrul rigs sngar lam bzhin bsdu len byas pa dang / phyir log rjes bsam phor snyan seng zhus par/ bsam phos khyed tshos 'phros mol byed dgos gsungs par brten de'i phyi lo 1951lor sngar bzhin khrul bsdur bskyod skabs smag sgo'i chu nag tu dmag sgar zhig 'dug pa kho pa tsho'i sar bskyod pas der sdod nyin dmag gis khyod tshos khrul bsdu chog dang mi chog nga tshos thag gcod mi thub/ nam zhu them pang zer ba'i sa char nyin rdu'i 'go dmag yod pas khyod tsho der 'gro dgos zhes zer ba dang / nga tsho'i go lag rnams de nas bsdus thog mi gnyis las phyin mi chog zer nas mi gnyis la nyin 20spa se zhig sprad byung / them pang du bskyod de nyin dmag la dmag sgo'i khrul rigs ni mnga' dwags rgyal gsum gyi mchod rgyun yin pas sngar rgyun khrul 'bab bsdu gi yin zhes gses bkrol byas kyang hin dmag gis nyan shes med par khrul bsdu mi chog ces bshad song / skabs der nyin dmag dang thug phrad byed skabs kyang phar lag rtags su star kha dang kham bu soṭa sprad pa dang / tshur yang 'jur ta dang 'o rtsam sogs sprad pa ma zad/ der thuṭa spro btang ste a rag kyang mang po blugs song / skad bsgyur rdo rje zhes pa zhig 'dug pa der lag rtags nyal zan zhig sprad pa yin/ de skabs nam zhu them pang pyi/ bdag po('go pa)dang / mon pa mi 'ga' shas kyang mnyam du yod/ de nas nga tsho tshur log yong skabs yar lam smag sgo'i mi ser khag gcig gis sngar lam khrul rigs 'jal sgru ba ma zhus na mchod rgyun gyi gtong dmigs la brten nga tsho'i 80

'brog las thon skyed lam lhong mi yong zhes lkog dang dngos nas khrul skyel mkhan 'ga' shas byung bas lo der khral dngos phran bu 'khyer rgyu byung / byams pa ngag dbang gis nyin rdu'i sne len thugs spro'i a rag btung mang drag pa'am/ gang ltar de nas bzung nad mnar gyis rang khyim du 'byor nas nyin 20yas mas su 'das grongs song ba phung po bya stor byed skabs khog pa'i nang rol tshang ma nag rkyang du gyur pa ma zad/ bya rgod kyis kyang za gi mi 'dugade'i phyi lo(1952)bu ye shes bstan 'dzin gyi a ma'i spun mched phyag dam o rgyan lags kyis kho tsho'i khyim tshang gi tshab byas te smag sgor khrul bsdur phebs shing / khong gi g.yog por nga rang dang de min gnyis bcas yod/ smag sgo chu nag tu slebs skabs nyin dmag gis bkag ste go lag kho tshor rtsis sprod bya dgos zer zhing / skabs der nga rang la me mda' zhig yod pa de ma sprad stabs kho pa tshos nga rang dang drel pa mi gcig der bkag pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i bca' dngos sngogs bsher byas stabs nga rang nas rnam 'gyur rtsub po bton rkyen shrī nā la(btson khang)'jug dgos 'dug gam zhes kyang brjod byung / o rgyan lags dang g.yog po gcig btang ba khong gnyis nas nyin dmag gi dmag sgar lte ba yod sar phyinagyinas 'phros mol byas te khrul bsdu rtsis yin kyang / nyin dmag gi bsdu mi chog ces nyag rkyang bshad stabs lo der khrul 'bab gang yang bsdu ma thub pa de nas bzung smag sgor 'gro mtshams chad pa red/ skabs der nyin rdus khrul bsdu ru ma bcug kyang smag mthin lu gsum ni gang ltar bod sa bston med yin la bsam grub pho brang gi 'dzin khongs kyang yin pa lo rgyus dang don dngos mang pos ra sprod byed kyi yod pa dper na/ smag mthin lu gsum nas‘‘bu gsum bar pa'i btsun khrul’ zhes dud tshang zhig la bu gsum yod na 'bring ba mkhar ltag dgon par(deng sang mtsho sna rdzong sbyor na chus mkhar ltag shang khongs ) 81

btsun khrul zhes grwa pa byed par gtong dgos pa'i sngar gyi lam srol yod mus ma zad/ smag sgo'i khongs bla kham zhes par lha khang chung ngu zhig yod pa de'i dkon gnyer yang mkhar ltag dgon pa nas gtong gi yod pa de dag gi thog nas kyang gong gsal smag mthin lu gsum ni bod kyi khongs gtogs bston med yin pa ha cang gsal po yod pa red / 82

196pya lor rta dbang la bskyod skabs kyi mkhrong khros/ bsod nams dpal 'byor/nga ni de snga bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bla phyag las khungs kyi las bya zhwa'utsali byed myong zhing / de snga bla phyag las khungs nas lo ltar lha ldan smon tshogs gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i lha mi'i mchod phogs kyi 'bras 'bab gtong dmigs su mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pas tshwa 'bras brje 'tshong gi thog nas gzhung 'bul 'bras dos lo rer thengs gnyis gsum re 'bul dgos shing / tshwa 'bras brje 'tshong gi las yul lte ba mon khul yin pas/ 1950lo phan tshwa 'bras brje 'tshong gi 'bras sgrub pa rim pa nas sngar lam 'gan dbang spyod mus kyang / 1951lo〈bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉la ming rtags bkod de mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur byung rjes nyin rdu srid gzhung nas ma rung khog bcangs kyis khrims 'gal gyi‘‘me khe ma hung sa thig’’zer bar bsnyad de bod kyi sa khongs bston med mon khul rgya che ham bzos kyis mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pa'i sngar lam 'gan dbang yang rtsis med du btang stabs mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pas sa gnas srid gzhung la dbus 'bul 'bras 'bab khyon che lo re thengs gnyis gsum re 'bul dgos de dag tshwa 'bras brje 'tshong byed skabs sger gyi tshong pa 83

spyi mtshungs las/ sngar srol sgo dud so sor tshwa 'bras mgo thug gi brje 'tshong bya lam bzhin ma byung bar tshwa 'bab 'phar 'thol sprod dgos pas 'bras sgrub pa'i ma rtsas kha 'khor min gyi gyong gun che ba tsam ma zad/ bod kyi bya gzhag gzhan dag gi dgos mkho dper na/ gsung rab bka' 'gyur gyis gtsos pa'i par shing stag pang dang / rtse dang / nor gling gzim chung khag sogs kyi nyams gso'i dgos mkho gcal pang rnams de snga spang chen lding drug dang / legs po tsho bzhi'i mi ser nas gshags las 'khri sgrub zhu ba de dag kyang mtshams chad nas pang leb rnams sger tshong spyi 'gre las nyo sgrub mi chog pa sogs mi bdag bdag bzung bdag po sgo phud kyi dpe bzhin bod sa bston med rgya gar bas ham bzung byed bab de dag 'phral phugs gang nas gyong gun ci che bzod thabs med par brten mtsho na rdzong dang / skabs de'i 'bras sgrub las thog phyag nang bsod dbang can nas sa gnas su 'byor pa'i rgya gar ba'i mi snar skad cha byas kyang kho pa tshos brjod gsal nga tshor thag gcod byed pa'i 'gan dbang med pas khyod tshos gzhung(rgya gar)dang phan tshun bka' mol gnang rgyu las nga tshos thag gcod mi thub ces bshad 'dug de'i skor 'bral sgrub pas bla phyag las khungal su snyan seng zhus par bla phyag nas mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pa'i 'bras 'bab phon che'i yong khungs chad na las khungs kyi gtong gron rgya 'ub 'dus min gyi dka' nyen che bar brten bka' shag la snyan seng zhus don bka' shag nas lho sdod 'bras spyi blon chen brgyud de skor sngar lam sor gnas dgos pa las gsar spros de rigs mi yong ba'i bka' mol gnang skad kyang gang ltar go shes cho bzo gang yang ma thon pa red/ de rjes krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis phyi 'brel thabs lam brgyud dpang rtags yig rigs dngos dpang khungs btsan ji snyed kyi ra sprod khungs skyel dang 'brel lugs mthun sngar gnas dgos pa'i bden mol thengs 84

mang mdzad kyang rgya gar bas nyan 'dzog med pa'i thog de bas mngon sum 'dzems med kyis 1962lo mtha' 'tshams la tshur rgol zing cha bslangs rkyen rang re'i bcings 'grol dmag gis rang spung rgol lan mi bslog ka med byung ste nyin dmag rnams mthar sgrod gtong skabs rang nyid kyang sgrig 'dzugs nas skabs der sa 'tshams su las kar gtong gnang mdzad don phyin pa yin/de snga ljongs yongs kyi sgo khru thems gzhung dang / mon khul sogs sa mtshams kyi skor yig dngos gang 'tshams mthong myong yod pa'i nang nas mon rta dbang dga' ldan rnam rgyal lha rtser grags pa ni bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dgos pa gal cher ched 'dzugs mdzad pa'i gzhung dgos 'bring gras lo rgyus deb gsal bzhin bod sa rtsod med yin pa'i myong tshor yod mus thog rta dbang du slebs rjes don dngos mthong tshul gyi thog nas de bas myong tshor zab mo byung zhing / khul der mtsho sna rdzong ser skyas khrul khrims sa srung skor sogs la do dam byed pa dang / mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pas tshong don thad do dam byed kyi yod pas 'bras sgrub pas tshwa 'bras brje 'tshong byas 'phros mi ser nas phyi 'tshong byas rigs la‘‘gzigs’ zer ba'i khrul bsdu len byed pa brgyud nas nyo 'tshong chog pa las/ de ma brgyud par nyo 'tshong mi chog pa'i 'gag sgo'i khral don lam lugs lag bstar byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ de bzhin rta dbang bla gnyer gyil mtsho sna dgon pa'i bsdu gtong gi 'bab sgo'i do dam dang / chos khrims byed sgo'i 'gan dbang spyod kyi yod pa bcas gong gsal de dag gi dbang cha'i khyab khongs ni spang chen lding drug legs po tsho bzhi/ dwags pa tsho brgyad/ stag lung rdzong dang /rdi rang rdzong / seng ge rdzong sogs yod pa ma zad/ de'i khongs rgya gar pas mon sa bed spyod byas pa'i sa gnas gcig gi sa rub zer ba'i sa gla spyi lo 1950bar gleng med sprod len byas pa'i lo rgyus yig dngos kyang yod/86

1950lor klo mon khul rgya gar bas sim 'dzul byas 'phral klo rdo lcags pas kho pa tsho phyir sgrod dgos pa'i skor rta dbang drug sbrel sogs la snyan seng zhus 'dug pa de'i thog nas mi ser gyis kyang rgya gar ba'i gsar spros la nad mi theg pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa gsal po mthong byung /da lta rta dbang dgon par yod bzhin pa'i bca' yig ni pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis bstsal ba zhig yin cing / der dgon pa'i blang dor byed sgo'i thad me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtshos gtan 'khel byas pa gzhir bzung ltar chos khrims byed sgo gang ci bstan pa'i mig rgyan du 'gro ba byed rgyus mtshon dgon pa'i phan bder drag zhan su thad nas phan sbyar gang yong dgos pa las gnod 'gal yong gzhi'i rigs nam yang mi chog pa'i skor sogs 'khod yod pa dang / de bzhin bca' yig rim can yod pa skabs der dngos mthong byung ba bcas mdor na lo rgyus dpang rtags khungs btsan de dag gi thog nas kyang mon rta dbang gis mtshon pa'i mon khul 'di dag sngar nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'dzin skyong byed pa'i mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bod sa bston med yin pa ra sprod gsal thag chod yod pa red/

〈rje 'bangs rnams kyi rigs rus kyi 'byung khungs gsal ba'i sgron me〉(mon chos 'byung)zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ rtsom sgrig pa'i gtam/ 〈rje 'bangs rnams kyi rigs rus kyi 'byung khungs gsal ba'i sgron me〉(mon chos 'byung yang zer)zhes pa 'di ni mon yul gyi bdag dbang skor gyi lo rgyus dpyad gzhi shin tu gal 'gangs che ba zhig yin stabs da lam nga tshos ched du par skrun byas pa yin/ 'di'i ma dpe'i zhal bshus dpe thung zhig bod rang skyong ljongs yig tshags khang nas mkho 'don gnang byung zhing / 'on kyang zhal bshus der yi ge ma dag pa dang chad lhag sogs yig nor mang la tshig don gong 'og mthud mi thub pa'am/ go don 'ga' zhig shin tu rtogs dka' ba/ le'u gong 'og 'khrugs pa sogs 'dug pa de dag da lam nga tshos par skrun skabs dag cha'i yig nor dogs chod gdeng 'khel thub nges 'ga' zhig bcos pa dang / le'u bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i gong 'og 'dres 'dzol bskyar bsgrigs/ gsal kha gtod dgos nges 'ga' zhig gug rtags nang zur du bris shing / de min ma dper gang yod rang sorabazhagayodapabacas/ da wa na mo ārya lo ke shā ra dha rmā ra dza sto dhi sa to ya/ /rgyal kun thugs rje gcig 'dus lhag pa'i lha/ / mtha' 'khob bod kyi ma rig mun gling 'dir/ / 7

gang 'dul thabs kyi cir yar skur ston pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang de'i snang brnyan sgyu ma'i zlos gar las/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'dzam gling skye 'gro 'phel/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i phyir/ /rgya gar mi rigs lha las sprul pas chad/ /bod kyi mi rnams spre'ur gyur pas 'phel/ /de dag dge ba'i thabs phyogs rtsol ba ni/ /rgya gar yul du mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal/ /gangs can bod du rje rgyal gnya' khri btsan/ /srong btsan 5ma po khri srong lde'u btsan dang / /sto phyogs mon du lha sras gtsang ma zhes/ /rnam par sprul pa'i skyes mchog de rnams kyi/ /gong la rje 'di'i gdung rabs 'byung khungs dang / /'og ma 'bangs kyi mi rabs byung tshul sogs/ /nges par gsal ba'i sgron ste/ 'di na gsal/ /'phags yul gangs can bod kyi chad khungs rnams/ /lo rgyus bstan bcos kun las mthong thos kyi/ /'jig rten rgan rabs mkhas pa'i ngag rgyun bzhin/ /kun gyis go bde'i nyer mkho cung zad tsam/ /brjod par spro yang snyigs dus skye bo rnams/ /mi spun gzu lum spyod pa'i shugs bgros kyis/ /ya rabs che btsun rje 'bangs mtho dman med/88

rigs rus 'chol bar song ba'i dus nyid la/ /rgyud khungs bshad kyang don med ngal ba'i rgyu/ / 'on kyang ma 'ong dus kyi skabs 'ga' rer/ /rigs rus mngon mtho dpa' mdzangs blo gros ldan/ /gnam bskos stobs kyis sa la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /rje rgyal rgyud pa nyi skar 'byung srid na/ / dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal snyan gyi dga' ston dang / /ya rabs pho nyams khrol mor gleng ba'i gtam/ /kun gyi rna ba'i thos rgyar mi spobs kyang / /mgrin dbyangs gsang ba'i glu chung 'di ltar len/ /de yang mdo sde padma dkar po las lung bstan pa bzhin ljon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bod gangs can gyi gling phyogs 'dir ri klung sa gzhi thams cad la mtsho chen po 'khyel zhing chags nas yod pa la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis spyan ras gzigs la lung bstan cing bka' bstsal ze/spyan ras gzigs kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes shing / thugs bskyed smon lam gyi stobs dran pa tsam la kong po chu brlag kha bye nas mtsho thams cad der thim nas sa gzhi lag mthil lta bur chags shing / sa la'i nags chen po byung bar gyur pas/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang jo mo sgrol ma'i thugs rjes rgyud bskul nas/ spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang brag srin mo gnyis bza' mir 'doms pa dang / spre'u phrug drug skyes pa las rim par 'phel ba dang spre'u phrug lnga brgyar song ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis skye bo gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa shin tu mdzes pa zhig tu sprul bas sprel tshe rnams kyis khyod kyi gzugs byad mdzes pa de ci las byung zer bas/ mi des mi dge ba bcu smyo

spong gi chos bshad pas spril chi rnams kyis kyang de bzhin nyams su blangs pas de rnams kyang rim pas mir gyur te/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis sprel rgan byang chub sems dpa' la 'bru sna lnga gnang nas spre'ur gyur pa'i mi rnams so nam gyi las la zhugal te/ lo thog smin pa dang / su thob dang hab thob brgyab nas 'thab cing rtsod pa ni/ steng na rje dpon med pa dang / 'og na 'bangs kyi rim pa med pas lan zer nas/ khong rang rnams kha mthun gyis rje dpon 'tshol ba'i 'dun ma 'grigs pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis rgya gar gyi rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i bu tha chung ru pa skyes bkug pa dang / bod kyi mi rje dpon 'tshol du phyin pa rnams dang rgyal po lha ri rol ba'i rtser 'phrad pa/ bod kyi mi rnams kyis mi de la khyed gang nas yin zhes dris par de dus rgya bod kyi skad ma go bas rgyal pos mdzub mo gnam du ker ba dang / khong rnams kyis 'di ni gnam nas yong ba'i lha yin par 'dug zer gnya' bar khri bzos nas 'khur yong bas/ rgyal po'i ming yang rje gnya' khri btsan po zhes btags so/ bod kyi rgyal por snga ba de yin no/ rgyal po de'i riṭa rus kyi 'byung khungs ji yin zhe na/ sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi rgyal po la snga ba rje mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po yin pa dang / de nas gdung rgyud rim gyis 'das pa'i rgyal rabs las/ rgyal po bha ra dha dza dang / go'u ta ma gnyis byung ste/ go'u ta ma la nyes pa med par nyes par bsgrags nas gsal shing gi rtse la bskyon nas khrug dang thig le 'dzag pa la smon lam btab pas/ sgo nga gsum du gyur pa bu ram shing lo'i gseb tu bzhag pas/ rgyal po khye'u chung gsum du gyur pa las/ gdung rgyud rim gyil 'phel ba'i bu ram shing pa'i rgyal rabs rgyud pa dus kyi dbang gis grong khyer chen po ser skyar gnas shing / ming sring lhan du bsdebs pa las byung ba'i rgyud pa la/ shākya chen po/ shākya li tsā byi/ shākya ri 90

rbuka pa zhis rgyal sdogs gsum du gye/ sa/spu las/ rje gnya' khri btsan ngo/ de ni shā tso li tsā byi'i rgyud pa yin no/ gnya' khri btsan po'i gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa lnga pa rgyal po lha tho tho ri snyan shal byon pa yin/ de nas gdung rabs lnga la rgyal po srong btsan sgam po byon pa yin/ de nas gdung rabs lnga la rgyal po khri srong lde btsan byon pa yin/ khri srong lde btsan la sras mu ni btsan po/ mu khri btsan po/sad na legs gsum byung bas/ sad na legs kyi sras khri ral pa can/ lha sras gtsang ma/ glang dar ma gsum byung ba'i khri ral pa can ni/ snying rje padma dkar po'i mdo las lung bstan pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa yin/ de nyid rgyal sar bskos nas 'dzam gling gi sa cha gsum gnyis la dbang ste stobs dang da mnga' thang lha'i longs spyod dang mnyam zhing / 'u shang rdo'i gtsug lag khang chen mo rgya phibs dgu thog dang bcas pa bzhengs te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa yong ched du dge 'dun 'dus grwa bcu gnyis/ bshad grwa bcu gnyis/sgom grwa bcu gnyis la sogs pa bod dbus gtsang khams yan chad dud wachosasde chen mo sum cu so drug btsugs pa/ rgya gar nas paṇi ta da na shrī la la sogs paṇḍi ta mang dag cig spyan drangs nas bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams chos thams cad skad gsar bcad du bsgyur du bcug cing / dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas pa dang /khyad par du'ang dge 'dun pa re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun re bsnyen bkur la sbyar zhing / rgyal po nyid kyi dbu'i ral pa la ras yug btags nas de'i steng la dge 'dun pa rnams bzhugs su bcug cing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bkur sti khams che ba bla na ma mchis par mdzad pa las/ mnga' 'bangs rnams la dka' las che tsam byung nges pa sdig blon rnams blos ma rangs par/ dbas rgyal to re dang / cog ro legs sgra gnyis kyis rgyal po bkrongs nas chos khrims bshig pa'i 'dun ma byas pas/ cog ro legs sgra na re/ rgyal po bkrongs kyang 91

lha sraṣpe/ gtsang ma dang / blon chen dpal gyi yon tan yod pas chos khrims bgigorimi thub zer bas/ dbas rgyal to res nga la thabs shig /mod zer nas bod dbus gtsang gi mo ma rtsis pa thams cad la nor rdzas kyi brngan pa sbyin nas thams cad kha mkhas smrar bcug pa la lha sras gtsang ma da lo bod khams 'dir bzhugs na/rgyal po dang lha sras gnyis kyi sku tshe la bar chad yong nyen che ba dang / khyad par bod khams 'dir nad yams dang / 'khrug rtsod la sogs pa yong ba 'dug zer nas thams cad kha mthun par smrar bcug nas smras pa dang / dbas rgyal to res rgyal po'i snyan du gsol bas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas gcung bcas da lo nged rang rnams kyi chags bsang pa dang / sto mon gyi mnga' 'bangs mi sde rnams kyi yul khams ji ltar yod dang / bde sdug ci 'dra yod gzigs pa la phebs pas chog zer ba bzhin sto mon spa gro(gro mo)phyogs la pheb pa dang / yang dbas rgyal to re dang / cog ro legs sgra gnyis kha mthun nas rgyal po'i btsun mo ngang tshul ma dang / blon chen dpal gyi yon tan gnyis/ rgyal pos ma mkhyen par gsang thabs kyis 'dod pa spyad nas nal bsham 'dug ces pa'i phra ma bcug pas/ mi bden pa'i gtam de thos pas/ btsun mo ngang tshul ma ha las te lcebs te shi ba rgyal pos phra ma la gsan nas/ blon chen dpal gyi yon tan me phung chen po'i nang la bcug nas bkum pa dang / sdig blon gnyis kyis glags rnyed nas/ rgyal po 'bras chang gsol te gzims pa la dbu ltag par bskor nas bkrongs so/ de nas glang dar ma rgyal sar bskos nas gtsug lag khang dang / sku gsung thugs rten rnams bshigs shing / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams gtor te khyi ra byed du bcugami nyan pa rnams bsad/ chos bsgyur 'phro rnams 'phro bcad nas paṇḍi ta rnams rang yul du slog sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ming tsam yang med par byas/lha sa'i gnas bdag ma cig dpal lhas thugs rgyud bskul nas lha lung dpal gyi 92

rdo rjes rgyal po glang dar ma bkrozlas so/ de la sras 'od srung dang / yum brtan gnyis byung ba sku nasason pas rgyal srid la ma 'cham par dbu ru dang / g.yo ru so sor phye nas lo bcu gnyis bar du 'khrugs pas rgyal khrims chos khrims gnyis ka med pa'i mun pa'i gling lta bur gyur nas lo bdun cu tsam song ba dang /sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i brtse bas gzigs nas gangs can mun pa'i gling du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i me ro smad nas langs te gsos shing / bar du dbus gtsang dar zhing rgyas pa'i tshul byung ba las bstan pa'i me ro smad nas langs pa ni/ bstan pa bsnubs pa'i dus gtsang rab gsal/g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya mu ni dang gsum dpal chen chu bo ri la sgoms shing yod tsa na btsun pas khyi ra byed pa mthong nas de'i lo rgyus dris pas rgyal pos bstan pa med par bzos pa gsan pas khong gsum mnyam du 'dul ba'i chos rnams dre 'ur bkal nas mdo khams la bros nas gnam rdzong brag la sgoms shing bzhugs so/ de'i dus su yul tsong khar skyes pa'i bon mu zu gsal 'bar zer ba'i byis pa de phyugs 'tshor phyin pas snang gsal lha khang de zhig ral du song ba'i nang gi ldebs ris logs la dge slong rab tu byung ba'i gzugs brnyan yod pa mthong nas byis pa shin tu spro dga' skyes nas de'i nye logs su rgan mo 'khar bar brten pa zhig yod pa de la 'di ci'i gzugs brnyan yin zer dris pas/rgan mo na re/ nga rang gzhon nu'i dus su dge slong rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs de bzhin sde mang po yod pa yin te/ glang dar mas chos kyi bstan po bsnub pa nas tshun chad med pa yin zer/ byis pa na re/ de dus kyi dge slong rnams sa cha gzhan la 'thor song ba med dam zer bas/ rgan mo na re/ gzhan la yod med mi shes dpal chen chu bo ri nas bros yong ba'i dge slong mdo khams gnam rdzong brag la bzhugs yod zer gyi 'dug zer bas/ byis pa des gnam rdzong brag la 93

phyin nas gtsang rab gsal/ g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya mu ni mjal nas gus pas btud cing / lhag par du chos 'dul ba la dad pas rab tu byung ste/ming dge ba rab gsal du btags/ phyis su thugs rab che bas chos sde snod thams cad thugs su chud pa nas bzung bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal zhes mtshan yongs su grags pas dbus brgyud bsam yas nas yum brtan gyi sras rgyud mtshan la ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes pa dam pa'i chos la dad pa bskyed nas klu mes shes rab tshul khrims la sogs pa mi bcu rab byung du brdzangs pa/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal las rab tu byung nas chos brgyud dbus gtsang du spel bas na bstan pa'i me ro smad nas langs pa ni de la zer ba yin/ stod nas gso ba ni/ glang dar ma'i sras 'od srung dang yum brtan gnyis byung ba las 'od srung gi sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan de'i sras bkra shis brtsegs dpal dang / skyid lde nyi ma mgon gnyis byung bas/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi sras dpal gyi mgon dang / sde gtsug mgon/ bkra shis mgon dang gsum byung bas bkra shis mgon gyi sras 'od kyi rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras srong nge dang / kho re gnyis byung bas srong nges gu ger mtho lding lha khang bzhengs pa dang / khong rang mkhan slob med par rab tu byung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan lha bla ma ye shes 'od du btags/sras gnyis kyang rab tu byung du bcug rgyal srid gcung gi sras lha sde la gtad/de la sras gsum byung ba'i ban lha btsun byang chub 'od yin/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / lha btsun byang chub 'od mes dbon gnyis kyis rin chen bzang po la sogs pa'i ban phrug nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar la btang ste/ lo tsā ba'i yon tan bslabs/ dam chos bod du bsgyur bcug pa dang / khyad par rin po che'i gser la ma gtsigs shing / rang gi lus srog la'ang gces pa med par phangs med du bsngos su bcug thog rgya gar nas paṇḍi ta lnga brgya'i nang gi gtsug rgyan jo bo 94

dpal ldan a ti sha zhes mtshan snyan nyi zlar grags pa de nyid mnga' ris gung thang du spyan drangs nas chos 'khor bskor ba dang / de nas dbus gtsang du phebs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par rgyun mthud(deng sang gi bar du yod pa de rnams yin no)zhes rgyal rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i sgron me las gangs can bod du mi rgyud 'phel zhing rje rgyal rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/de nas yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang / gangs can bod du byung ba'i stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal rabs rim byon gyi gdung rgyud rgyas pa ni/rgyal rabal gsal ba'i me long dang / dpag bsam ljon pa sogs rgyal rabs khungs ldan dag las gsal bas 'dir ma bkod/ de yang rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long las lho phyogs mon gyi rgyal po rnams lha sras gtsang ma'i gdung rgyud yin gsungs 'dug pa dang / da lta'ang rgyal rigs dang mi sde thams cad kyi gtam rgyun las/ rgyal rigs thams cad rgyal mkhar mi zin pa las so sor gyes pa'i gleng gtam kho nar kun mthun kyang / 'ga' shas nas so so'i 'dod gtam nga rgyal gyis nga yin khyed min zer ba dang / gzu lum gyi gtam lha sras gtsang ma nas sras rgyud gdung rabs bcu tsam re bgrang nas de'i bu nga yin zer nas nges rtags kho na smras pa dang / la las sras rgyud kyi rim pa 'di yin 'di min zer nas rtsod cing rang rang so so'i 'di rang yin zer ba ni/ ma rig blo rmongs shes rig med pa kho na yin te/ dper na mi gcig la ming mang po yong ba kun shes ltar la pha mas chung dus bkra shis mnga' gso/la nas btags pa'i ming dang /gces par bskyangs nas btags pa'i ming dang / bya ba'i gnas skabs dang /byad la sogs pa'i ming dang / che sar bkur ba'i zhe sa che brjod kyi ming dang 95

bcas ji snyed yod pas gci ga tu 'dzin pa ni dpyad dka'o/ la las/ lha sras gtsang ma sto mon du phebs nas lo grangs nge tsam song ba dang / gdung rabardoge ji tsam song gi khungs ma chod par sras rgyud rim pa 'di yin 'a di min gyi 'byung khungs nges rtags ltar brjod pa ni nga rgyal dang dregs pa'i gtam gye bab co'/ lo/dper na lo'i nges pa ni mkhas grub lha dbang blo'i bstan rtsis gdan dus thun mong las/ khri ral gshegs pa dang / glang dar mas rgyal po byas tshun 'od srung pa dang / lha sras gtsang ma yang de'i dus su lho mon la phebs par nges pa yin pas/ de nas lo lnga la rgyal po glang dar ma lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bkrongs pa yin/ de nas lo bcu la sras 'od srung dang yum brtan gnyis 'khrupo/sa shing /gong gi me pho 'brug nas da lta'i dbus gtsang 'khrugs pa'i sa pho sprel lo yan chod la lo grangs brgya phrag brgyad dang sum cu so gsum song ba rgya bod mkhas pa'i yang rtse rnam gling paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis deb ther las glang dar mari sras 'od srung ste gdung rabs nyi shu 'das gsungs pa dang / da lta'i sa pho sgel ji shrīn chod la lha sras gtsang ma'i gdung rabs kyang nyi shu rtsa gcig 'das nas da lta rtsa gnyis rtsa gsum steng la phyogs/ des na shes ldan mkhas pa nyams myong rig rtsal che ba rnams kyis brtag par dpyad pa'i spyod yul du rags pas so/ de nas gong du bshad pa'i 'phro la dpon g.yog lnga tsam lho brag phyogs la byon rtsis yin kyang /sngon gyi smon la ma gyi dbang gis gtsang phyogs phag ri phyogs las spa gro gnam thang dkar po la phebs nas de bar la bud med shin tu mdzes shing lang tsho dang ldan pa brtse grogs la brten nas lha sras nyid tshur phebs pa'i rjes la phyis bu mo de las bu yan pa gcig btsas pa dang / 'ga' re nas lha sras gtsang ma'i yan bu yin pa 'dra zer ba'i rgyud da lta spa gro'i rgyal gdung zer ba dang / thim bu'e gdung 'brog rus chen rnams yin ces pa'i 'phros gtam re yang zer gyi 'dug96

de nas rim pas thim bu'i gzhung chu pho chu mo dbang 'dus pho brang bar grong zam pa brga/la nas shar lung sgor mo la slebs/ de nas rim pas kho dang tsā/ / sngan lung lang de lung pa/ kheng / kyi li/ tung la mbi/ gzhong dkar mol ba lung pa rnams rim pas bgrod cing / ku ri chu la slebs pa dang / chu bo'i stod smad gang la bltas kyang zam pa med par ha las te/ ci drag la thug nas bsam blo zhig thong nas lha sras kyi thugs la nga lung phyogs 'di la gnas shing dbang basbyar ba'i skal ba yod na zam pa tshugs par gyur cig zer lha la dmod bor nas shing sdong gcig bcad cing sgyel bas chu phan tshun 'brel ba'i zam pa lta bur byung bas chu bo barbal nas rtsang skor ri'i la rtsa brgal nas snga tshang gi sa cha dang / shi ri chu brgal nas ba geng bre mo he long / rtseng me'i sa cha rnams bgrod nas byams mkhar la slebs/ tshang zam gyi sar thon te mu ga btang mkhar thum bur zer ba'i spang log la slebs shing logs nas bltas pas gong ri grang ma'i chu rgyud de lung pa'i khad yangs shing dwangs gsal ba 'dug pa nas lha sras thugan/ nyamasdo/ spro ba'i snang ba zhig byung nas dngul gyi mda' zhig yod pa der gces sheng 'phangs pa'i shul du chu byung / da lta'i dngul sgoms zer ba de yin no/ yang byon pa'i zhor la gser gyi mda' zhig yod pa de 'phangs pas chu byung bas da lta'i gser sgorā sa zer ba de yin no/ de nas lngang gser kung sar slebs nas phyogs mtha' la gzigs pas lung pa dwangs spro ba yod kyang / mi dang grong zhing re gnyis las med pas der bzhugs ma spro/ de dus lho mon gyi lung phyogs sa gang la'ang rgyal po khyi kha ra thod dang mnyam du yong ba'i mi thor bu re bzung ba'i khyim zhing thor bu re las med pas lha sras kyang phebs shing bzhugs ma spro bar rim pas 'di phyogs la phebs pa 'dug go de nas lha sras gnyis kyis mi rnams la/ mi dang grong gang la mang dang / sa gzhi bzang zhes dris pas mi rnams kyis la 'og yu/la 97

gsum dpal mkhar bzang zer bas rim pas dpal mkhar du phebs nas bzhuṭa pas bod khamarngasdo la sdig(sdig rgyal)dang sdig blon kha mthun nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig zer ba'i skad cha thos byung ba dang / bod yul dang thag nye ba'i gshis kyis der bzhugs ma spro bar 'brong mdo gsum btsan mkhar la phebs nas rgyal sa bzung ba'i 'os gang la 'dug gzigs pas mi zin pa'i sa cha de chu brag gis bskor zhing lung pa 'dus che la sa btsan sa 'dug dgongs nas der phebs pas de na a mi don grub rgyal zer ba'i mi zhig gis bdag po byas pa'i mi khyim zhig 'dug par lha sras kyis don grub rgyal la gsungs par/ khyed rnams 'dir 'ongs nas mi rabs ci tsam song / rigs rus lung phyogs gang nas yin zer bas don rgyal gyis smras pa yul phyogs bod yul nas nga'i pha ma'i dus la yong ba yin/ rigs rus ni slob dpon padma'i dngos slob a mi byang chub 'dre bkol(khams pa go cha)/ rlangs lha gzigs kyi rgyud pa/ byar po'i yul du yod par pha spun nang 'khrugs nas mnga' 'bangs dbang rgyu ma byung ba las 'dir yong ba yin zer ba'i lo rgyus zhib cha zhus pas lha sras kyang yid ches nas der gnas tshang bca' nas bzhugs pa a mi don grub rgyal dang rigs rgyud gcig pa ni/ deng sang mo gu(phag mo gru)pa'i sne gdong gong ma chen mo zer ba dang rus gcig pa yin 'dug go a mi don grub rgyal gyi bu mo bsod nams dpal sbyin lha sras gtsang ma'i btsun mor blangs pas/ sras khri mi lha'i dbang phyug dang bu mthong legs can gnyis 'khrungs nas sku nar son pa dang / mi khyim yul grong thor bur yod pa rnams la dbang bsgyur nas rgyal mkhar brtsigs pas bod chos rgyal gyi gdung zhes grags pa cher song ba dang / khri mi lha'i dbang phyug de la 'og yul gsum nas blon 'bangs rnams kyis rje dpon gnas su gdan drangs nas phebs pas phyis sras rgyud rnams lha'u kham pa la bzhugs pas kham pa jo bo zer 98
